Retrained on the certified selection, the strongest full-label method becomes safe where no setting of its own cost target rescues it. Refusal is predictable: the certificate's probability has a closed form in the purity the pool attains, which the calibration sample estimates and the scorer enters only through.

title: Inverting Self-Triggered Control: Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Sparse Denial-of-Service Attacks
summary: Self-triggered reinforcement learning control (RL-STC) learns the sparsest control schedule that preserves Lyapunov-decreasing stability under a Run-Time Assurance (RTA) override. We invert this: an adversarial RL agent learns the sparsest jamming or Denial-of-Service (DoS) schedule that destabilizes the closed loop, with a Lyapunov-increase admissibility predicate mirroring the defender's safety certificate. We prove a plant-property lower bound on the minimum jam count required for an immediate hold-last medium-access-control adversary to force a crash against a self-triggered controller (STC) satisfying a Lyapunov contract, and recover a certificate-level analog of the consecutive-grouping optimality of prior count-budget DoS scheduling as a corollary. This extends the DoS-scheduling count-budget analysis from periodic and linear-time-invariant to STC controllers. Empirically, we train against four fixed defenders per plant (one Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) and three RL-STC) on Pendulum, CartPole, and Quadrotor2D. The learned adversary is the only adversary that crashes every defender on every plant at $100\%$: greedy misses Quadrotor2D LQR on $42\%$ of episodes and periodic misses Pendulum LQR on $97\%$. On jam-time-per-failure it beats baselines by up to $2.8\times$, and shows its widest absolute margin on Quadrotor2D LQR. Robustness ablations show that Gaussian observation noise exceeding the initial-state magnitude and position-only observation both preserve $100\%$ failure rate and keep the learned adversary strictly ahead of both baselines on jam-time-per-failure.

title: When Agent Metrics Measure Different Things: An Evidence-Grounded Audit of the Praxa AI Pipeline
comments: 22 pages, 4 figures. Retrospective measurement audit with aggregate data, offline analysis code, and a prospective, unexecuted operator-coverage catalog in ancillary files
summary: Agent evaluations can be numerically correct while measuring a different construct from the one implied by their labels. We present a retrospective measurement audit of selected Praxa AI implementation files, historical evaluation artifacts, and operational records. A 139-case offline routing report contains 112 passes and 27 failures despite zero gating failures, because known gaps are explicitly exempted from the gate. An identifier-free export represents 8,843 tool-attempt rows: 8,395 recorded durations and 448 missing values. Of the durations, 121 equal the signed 32-bit maximum and carry abandoned-client labels; inspected database code clamps elapsed lifecycle age. The pooled recorded 99th percentile is 2,147,483,647 ms, versus 38,118.31 ms among server-observed completed calls. This is a stratum contrast, not a treatment effect. In a documented single-trajectory compaction pilot, the reported follow-up input reduction is 94.39%, but the reduction across the trigger and follow-up calls together is 46.54%. We reproduce the descriptive calculations, verify 91 timing statistics through a separate weighted rational-arithmetic implementation, and execute 13 scoring-function and 12 analysis-verifier tests. Finite-completion bounds show how missing durations limit all-row timing statements without imputing values. The contribution is a source-linked case study and reusable verification package for separating gate policy, lifecycle timing, and request-level accounting from broader agent-performance claims. Historical provider runs and the full current pipeline were not independently reproduced; general capability superiority and population-level statistical significance are not established.
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Retrospective measurement audit with aggregate data, offline analysis code, and a prospective, unexecuted operator-coverage catalog in ancillary files

title: Toward Reliable Railway-Bogie Response Prediction Using Multifidelity TDNN and Physics-Informed Residual Learning
summary: Railway engineers need simulation models that predict vehicle responses across operating scenarios that cannot be tested exhaustively. Agreement with representative measurements provides essential evidence, but calibration at a limited set of conditions does not guarantee accuracy elsewhere. We present a multifidelity railway-bogie response-correction method that treats multibody simulation histories as low-fidelity information and roller-rig measurements as high-fidelity evidence. This method combines an experiment-anchored fidelity assignment with physics-informed discrepancy learning for multichannel bogie-response histories. A time-delay neural network (TDNN) represents the condition-dependent simulation trend, and development-fitted amplitude alignment defines the low-fidelity baseline. A residual-correction network then models the reproducible response component not explained by this baseline and adds it to the baseline. An effective dynamic-balance equation constrains the learned discrepancy by representing differences in inertia, damping, stiffness, and external forcing between the simulated and physical systems. The training objective combines this constraint with residual matching, temporal smoothness, and selectively applied displacement-acceleration consistency terms. For the evaluated reconstruction case, the corrected response gives a mean coefficient of determination of 0.8197, a mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) of 4.6055 %, and a mean normalized mean absolute error (NMAE) of 1.9297 %. These results provide initial evidence of accurate response prediction at the held-out 385 km/h condition.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Syndrome Extraction
summary: A key subtask of quantum error correction is to extract a syndrome that, if nontrivial, signals an error. The number of possible ways to extract a syndrome grows exponentially with the syndrome size, and these implementations vary greatly in fault tolerance, as measured by their logical error rates. This creates a natural search problem: find an implementation with a low logical error rate. Previous work solves this problem but sacrifices either solution quality or scalability. In this paper, we use reinforcement learning and importance sampling to outperform previous work at all scales. Compared with the state of the art automatic scheduling tools AlphaSyndrome and PropHunt, our tool reduces the logical error rate by 25.9\% and 71.7\% on average, respectively, culminating with a reduction of 97.8\% for a surface code with distance 15.

title: Computing the Shortest Even Directed-Cycle Length in $\widetilde{O}(n^4)$ Time
summary:
Björklund, Husfeldt, and Kaski gave a randomized $\widetilde{O}(n^{ω+3})$-time algorithm for computing the length of a shortest even cycle in an $n$-vertex directed graph, where $ω$ is the square matrix multiplication exponent. Their algebraic framework evaluates a parity cycle-cover enumerator over a field of characteristic two by lifting the computation to a ring of characteristic four. We give a direct evaluator for nonsingular matrices that stays in characteristic two. If $A$ is nonsingular over a field of characteristic two, the sum of the monomials indexed by odd permutations can be computed deterministically using $O(n^3)$ field operations. The key is an inverse-based closed form for a matrix with two proportional rows, combined with row elimination and dynamic inverse maintenance.
  For a directed graph, we apply the evaluator to $I+zW$, where $W$ is a randomly weighted adjacency matrix. The determinant $\det(I+zW)$ has constant coefficient one, so among any $2n+1$ distinct field elements at least $n+1$ yield nonsingular matrices. Evaluating at these points and interpolating gives a Monte Carlo algorithm that computes the shortest even-cycle length in $\widetilde{O}(n^4)$ time, with error probability $O(n^{-3})$. The error is one-sided with respect to existence: on a graph without an even cycle the algorithm always reports that fact. The result concerns the length; the standard self-reduction produces a cycle in $\widetilde{O}(n^5)$ time.

title: Fast matrix multiplication via recursive $\langle$ 4x4x4:48 $\rangle$ algorithms into practice
summary: We present a fast algorithm for multiplying two 4x4 matrices using 48 multiplications and 216 other operations (addition, subtraction or scaling by a constant) over any ring containing an inverse of 2. Applied recursively, this algorithm reaches a cost bound with leading term $7.75 n^{\log_4(48)}$. This is, up to our knowledge, the best-known leading constant in the cost for matrix multiplication algorithms with exponent $log_4(48)$. We further present an alternative basis version of this algorithm, reducing the leading term to $6.5 n^{\log_4(48)}$ by minimizing the extra cost after the change of basis.

title: Reading the Whole Heart: Latent-Attention Masked Autoencoders for Multimodal Cardiac Representation Learning
summary: Cardiovascular diagnosis rests on integrating complementary modalities, like ECG, echocardiography, chest radiographs, and clinical variables, each capturing distinct but correlated aspects of cardiac physiology. Yet most medical foundation models remain modality-specific, combining modalities only for finetuning or post-training. This discards the cross-modal evidence clinicians naturally integrate and ignores the structure within each modality. We introduce Latent-Attention Masked Autoencoders (LAMAE), a multimodal, structure-aware masked autoencoder that jointly learns patient-level representations during self-supervised pretraining. Rather than fusing modalities post hoc, LAMAE exchanges information directly in the latent space through a shared latent-attention module operating over a study-view-entity hierarchy, enabling aggregation of variable observations and graceful handling of missing modalities. Pretrained on over 1.2 million MIMIC-IV hospital stays, LAMAE outperforms modality-specific pretraining and strong contrastive and vision-language baselines across multimodal hospital-stay tasks, such as in-hospital mortality, ICD-10 and DRG coding, and length of stay, while remaining competitive on unimodal tasks. These gains persist even when only a single modality is available at test time, showing that modeling both intra- and inter-modal structure yields more robust, transferable representations.

title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
summary: In this technical report, we propose Pelican-Sim 1.0, a general world model simulator for embodied intelligence that predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions to support downstream learning and decision making. The model incorporates four key design features: (1) Unified action representation: a 28-dimensional action value space covering most mainstream embodiments, keeping one model valid across heterogeneous devices. (2) Action-visual injection: URDF- and camera-rendered action videos bridge actions and pixels, giving markedly better controllability across embodiments, scenes, and tasks (PSNR +0.904 over alternative fusion baselines). (3) Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE): sparse MoE layers add capacity for heterogeneous dynamics and absorb the action modality while reducing inter-modality conflict (FVD -6.530 vs. the dense backbone). (4) Efficient rollout generation: causal adaptation and few-step distillation yield a four-step autoregressive simulator, achieving a 5.67-fold speedup over the 35-step model. Benefiting from these designs, we train on approximately one million real-world and simulated trajectories and obtain large gains in action controllability and video quality: PSNR improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by 4.636 on AgiBotWorld Beta, 2.080 on RoboMIND, and 10.343 on RoboTwin, with the adapted EWMBench DYN score up 0.426 on RoboTwin. Relying on this, four downstream applications on RoboTwin succeed: 500 generated trajectories added to 50 demonstrations per task raise policy success from 70% to 93%; policy evaluation reaches a Pearson correlation of 0.994 across five checkpoints; and relative success gains reach 47.7% for action selection and 20.3% for policy improvement. Qualitative generalization across trajectory, scene, object, embodiment, and viewpoint shifts highlights its potential as a general-purpose world model simulator.

title: One Click to Leak: Characterizing the Real-World Usage and Threat Impact of MNO-based Single Sign-On Websites
comments: 19 pages. To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS 2026), The Hague, Netherlands
summary: Mobile Network Operator (MNO)-based Single Sign-On (MSSO) is a password-free authentication framework relying on mobile data sessions. Unlike traditional SSO, it shifts the Identity Provider (IdP) to the MNO and the authentication anchor to the Service Provider (SP). MSSO is increasingly deployed and has expanded from mobile apps to websites, yet its web ecosystem and security risks remain largely unexplored. We analyze mainstream MSSO deployments and identify a 3-phase workflow with three trust defects enabling trust hijacking. We further demonstrate One-Click-to-Leak (OCL) attacks, where a single webpage visit can leak sensitive identity information (e.g., phone numbers). With a leading security company, we conduct the first large-scale, longitudinal study of web-based MSSO. We design a hierarchical detection framework using passive DNS correlations and URL reconstruction from search data to identify MSSO-enabled websites. Over one year, we identified 116,852 website URLs across 729 apex domains. Of these URLs, 73.6% exhibit at least one trust defect: 69.4% expose developer credentials, and 27.1% issue high-privilege tokens before user consent, indicating widespread OCL-enabling trust defects. Among the 729 apex domains, 31.8% rely on Resellers, obscuring the downstream SP from the MNO in the analyzed flows. Script analysis identifies 101 websites strongly associated with OCL attack behavior. With our partner, we trace a representative upstream platform subsequently seized by law enforcement and uncover a monetized underground ecosystem. Sanitized backend data shows that it collected 14,100 users' phone numbers within three days and linked them to sensitive information such as browsing activity. Our work provides a comprehensive study of web-based MSSO deployment and security implications. Through responsible disclosure, our work helps secure the mobile authentication ecosystem.
comment: 19 pages. To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS 2026), The Hague, Netherlands

title: Reality Is the Final Verifier: On Two Key Gaps in Agentic Software Engineering
summary:
Software development follows an implementation-verification loop in which developers or agents iteratively revise an implementation until an evaluator, such as a test suite, accepts it. The evaluator checks the implementation against a set of requirements under a model of the deployment environment. Yet even a formal proof that the implementation satisfies the requirements under the model cannot guarantee acceptable behavior after deployment. Requirements only approximate stakeholder intent, and the model only approximates the real deployment environment. We call these together - requirement gap and model gap - the two-gap framework, which unifies the main failure modes of agentic software engineer-ing: reward hacking exploits omissions in the requirements or model, while hallucination widens the gaps by fabricating requirements or environment assumptions.
  Because neither gap can generally be certified closed in an open, changing world, the goal shifts from closing them to continuously narrowing them. We therefore propose an assurance-revision loop that uses deployment evidence to revise the requirements, model, or evaluator when stakeholders reject the resulting behavior. We then cast assured agentic development as a resource-allocation problem over human judgment, agent capability, and compute. The two principal bottlenecks mirror the two gaps: human judgment for the requirement gap and faithful, costly evaluation for the model gap. Reality remains the final verifier: acceptable behavior under actual deployment conditions is the ultimate test, while predeployment evaluations remain proxies for it.

title: Scalable Discrete-to-Continuous Channel Simulation for Compression and Privacy
summary: Channel simulation has recently emerged as a useful component in machine learning systems where samples from a prescribed probability distribution are to be compressed. Yet, general channel simulation algorithms often suffer from high computational costs, random stopping times or, in the worst case, can require generating an infinite number of shared random samples. We introduce a scheme for both exact and approximate simulation of discrete-to-continuous channels which conversely uses a fixed number of random samples, and therefore has a runtime independent of the channel and the input. Unlike existing channel simulation schemes which generate a sequence of independent samples from a proposal distribution, our approach generates one sample, or alternatively a fixed number of samples, from each potential target distribution. We then apply a latent permutation to the samples before performing sample selection using an exponential race. Our scheme provides a flexible tradeoff between the number of generated samples and the compression rate. Using polar and multilevel coding, we scale our approach to handle long blocklengths in $O(n \log n)$ time in order to benefit from reduced per-symbol overhead. We conclude by demonstrating applications to variable-rate compression with stochastic VQ-VAEs and communication-efficient differentially private distributed mean estimation via exact simulation of the Gaussian mechanism.

title: Feedback Capacity of Stationary Gaussian Channels: An Optimal Schalkwijk-Kailath Scheme
summary: We consider channels with additive colored Gaussian noise and noiseless feedback. Kim's seminal work derived a stationary variational characterization of feedback capacity and further asserted that the capacity-achieving stationary input need not contain a feedback-independent Gaussian component. These results led to the construction of a simple coding scheme, based on the Schalkwijk--Kailath (SK) refinement principle, which was shown to be capacity-achieving. A recent note identified a gap in the proof of the feedback-independent component-removal assertion, thereby leaving the optimality of the SK scheme and subsequent results that rely on it incomplete. In this paper, we prove the component-removal assertion for channels with stationary Gaussian noise that has a rational power spectral density. Our proof uses a perturbation analysis of a convex optimization formulation of feedback capacity and, indeed, shows that every optimizer assigns zero power to the feedback-independent component. Using this stronger property, we construct from any optimizer an explicit SK coding scheme that achieves every rate below feedback capacity with doubly-exponentially decaying maximal error probability.

title: "The Only Thing Certain About This is Uncertainty": Exploring Informal Care Coordination Practices Among Older Adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment
comments: To be published at ACM CSCW 2026 in October 2026
summary: Older adults aging in place often have informal support systems to help them maintain independence and quality of life. As they age, many older adults deal with the onset of Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), which introduces a new set of functional and cognitive changes that affect their ability to manage daily routines. The approach to arranging and coordinating support for everyday activities for older adults with MCI varies across informal care networks, but typically involves a primary care partner and a network of family, friends and others. In this paper, we present a thematic analysis of in-depth interviews with older adults with MCI and their primary care partners to gain a holistic picture of their day-to-day lived experience. Our analysis uses a multi-dimensional lens of people ("who"), activities ("what"), and tools ("how") to reveal insights about the nature of informal care coordination in MCI. Our results characterize informal care for MCI as a set of complex orchestration tasks by a primary care partner that support the practical, cognitive and emotional needs of the diagnosed individual and mediate the involvement of the broader care network. We uncover that coordination is not solely a matter of logistical organization, but also a deeply relational process shaped by negotiation with technological tools and evolving roles. Through this work, we reframe care coordination for MCI as a distinct and underexplored design space, one that demands systems capable of scaffolding autonomy, adapting to shifting capacities, responding to socio-emotional needs, and fostering collaborative caregiving.
comment: To be published at ACM CSCW 2026 in October 2026

title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Management and Serving for Robot Factories
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show high robotic manipulation capabilities via a two-stage design: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) stage followed by an Action Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) stage. Since robots must meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) for safety, VLA inference is inherently latency-critical. Meeting these SLOs requires high-end GPUs, yet weight, cost, and power constraints preclude integrating such GPUs on-robot. Prior works offload VLA inference to edge servers that serve many robots on VLA models. However, current VLA systems lack support for multi-request, multi-model execution on a multi-GPU server under SLOs, while existing serving systems for multi-stage models are optimized for throughput and stage disaggregation across separate GPUs, which are ill-suited for the millisecond-scale stages of VLA models. We design Robion, the first VLA serving and management system for multi-robot, multi-model requests on multi-GPU edge servers that meets SLOs. Our serving engine disaggregates the VLM and ADiT stages within a GPU via two streams, dynamically restricting the SMs on VLM stream so ADiT always finds SMs to run alongside it, and co-locates multiple models by sharing these streams across them, prioritizing requests by least remaining SLO time. Our management engine enables flexible model placements on multi-GPU servers, and integrates an intelligent traffic controller that maximizes per-model batching under the chosen placement while bounding each GPU's load to meet SLOs. For individual models, Robion serves on average 6.7$\times$ and 1.5$\times$ higher robot load within 98% SLO attainment over vLLM-Omni, the most widely used multi-stage serving system, and Monolithic, which runs VLM and ADiT as a single pipeline, respectively. In a large-scale experiment of serving 8 different models on a 4-GPU server, Robion can serve up to 64 robots within 98% SLO attainment.

title: Accelerating the Local Push Primitive for PageRank Computation
summary:
We propose a local algorithm that computes an $\varepsilon$-approximate PageRank vector in the sense of Andersen, Chung, and Lang (ACL; Internet Math. 2007) with teleportation parameter $α$ in $\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \bigl(\sqrtα \, \varepsilon\bigr)\bigr)$ time with high probability, improving the $O\bigl(1/(α\varepsilon)\bigr)$ running time of their original local push method. Our method also applies to the $\ell_1$-regularized PageRank problem with a running time of $\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \bigl(\sqrtα \, ρ\bigr)\bigr)$ for regularization parameter $ρ$, giving a positive answer to the open problem posed by Fountoulakis and Yang (COLT 2022).
  Our faster primitive has the potential to improve a broad range of graph algorithms that rely on local push. For example, substituting our primitive into the ACL framework directly yields faster PageRank-based local graph clustering, and we also develop reductions that lead to faster algorithms for effective resistance estimation.
  Our main technical contribution is a potential-function analysis of a refinement of the active-set method of Wei and Yang (preprint 2026), which repeatedly invokes an SDD solver on the current active set of nodes and expands the set. We relate the potential decreases over consecutive blocks of expansions to show that the number of expansions is bounded by $\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \sqrtα\bigr)$.

AI.title_translation: 加速PageRank计算的局部推送原语
AI.tldr: 提出了一种更快的局部算法，用于计算近似PageRank，将运行时间从$O(1/(\alpha\varepsilon))$改进到$\widetilde{O}(1/(\sqrt{\alpha}\varepsilon))$，并解决了$\ell_1$-正则化PageRank的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的局部推送方法在PageRank计算中运行时间较慢，本文旨在加速这一原语，从而提高依赖于局部推送的各种图算法的效率。
AI.method: 提出了一种局部算法，其主要技术贡献是对Wei和Yang的活跃集方法（反复调用SDD求解器并扩展集合）的改进进行了势函数分析。通过关联连续扩展块的势能下降来证明扩展次数的界限。
AI.result: 该算法以高概率在$\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \bigl(\sqrt\alpha \, \varepsilon\bigr)\bigr)$时间内计算出$\varepsilon$-近似PageRank向量，改进了ACL原始局部推送方法的$O\bigl(1/(\alpha\varepsilon)\bigr)$运行时间。它还适用于$\ell_1$-正则化PageRank问题，运行时间为$\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \bigl(\sqrt\alpha \, \rho\bigr)\bigr)$，解决了Fountoulakis和Yang提出的开放问题。该更快的原语有望改进广泛的图算法，例如PageRank局部图聚类和有效电阻估计。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提出一种加速局部推送原语的新算法，显著提高了近似PageRank计算的效率，解决了相关开放问题，并为更广泛的图算法提供了性能提升的潜力。
AI.translation:
我们提出了一种局部算法，它以高概率在$\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \bigl(\sqrt\alpha \, \varepsilon\bigr)\bigr)$时间内计算Andersen, Chung和Lang (ACL; Internet Math. 2007) 意义上的$\varepsilon$-近似PageRank向量，其中传送参数为$α$，这改进了他们原始局部推送方法的$O\bigl(1/(\alpha\varepsilon)\bigr)$运行时间。我们的方法也适用于$\ell_1$-正则化PageRank问题，对于正则化参数$\rho$，运行时间为$\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \bigl(\sqrt\alpha \, \rho\bigr)\bigr)$，这为Fountoulakis和Yang (COLT 2022) 提出的开放问题提供了一个积极的答案。
我们更快的原语有可能改进依赖于局部推送的广泛图算法。例如，将我们的原语直接替换到ACL框架中，可以直接得到更快的基于PageRank的局部图聚类，我们还开发了导致更快算法的约简，用于有效电阻估计。
我们的主要技术贡献是对Wei和Yang (preprint 2026) 的活跃集方法（它反复调用当前活跃节点集上的SDD求解器并扩展该集合）的改进进行了势函数分析。我们通过关联连续扩展块的势能下降来证明扩展次数由$\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \sqrt\alpha\bigr)$限制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的局部算法，显著加速了$\varepsilon$-近似PageRank向量的计算，将其运行时间从$O\bigl(1/(α\varepsilon)\bigr)$提升至$\widetilde{O}\bigl(1 / \bigl(\sqrtα \, \varepsilon\bigr)\bigr)$。该算法还成功解决了$\ell_1$-正则化PageRank问题的一个开放挑战。通过对活跃集方法的改进进行势函数分析，该研究不仅在理论上取得了突破，还为PageRank局部图聚类和有效电阻估计等多种图算法提供了实际的性能提升潜力。
AI.keywords: PageRank, 局部推送, 近似算法, 图算法, 势函数分析
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它显著改进了PageRank计算中局部推送原语的运行时间，解决了长期存在的开放问题，并展示了其在广泛图算法中的应用潜力。势函数分析是其核心技术贡献，为性能提升提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Deriving the Pure Price of Anarchy for Networked Resource Allocation Games
summary: This work considers multi-agent coordination with arbitrary information networks among the agents using a game-theoretic approach. A system designer aims to assign local utility functions to the agents to guide their actions toward a desired system objective. The performance of the assigned local utilities is measured by the well known pure price of anarchy (pPoA) metric that equals the ratio of the system objective at the worst pure Nash equilibrium of the corresponding game to the optimal system objective. Our aim is to derive the utility functions which optimize the pPoA-based performance guarantees for any given information network and system objective. We develop a linear program that derives the optimal pPoA for any arbitrary information network and arbitrary system objective. Our work is the first to solve optimal utility design for arbitrary networks; our techniques generalize previous approaches which considered only the full-information setting. For supermodular objective functions, we prove that counterintuitively, a fully communication-denied utility design is optimal irrespective of the original information network. For submodular system objectives, an exhaustive numerical analysis suggests that the optimal utility design is robust to communication failures even for this case. When the system objective is weighted maximum coverage, the marginal contribution utility design provably optimizes the pPoA for a wide variety of information networks of interest.

AI.title_translation: 导出网络化资源分配博弈的纯无政府价格
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种线性规划方法，用于在任意信息网络和系统目标下，设计最优的代理效用函数，以优化纯无政府价格（pPoA）性能保证。对于超模目标函数，无通信效用设计是最佳的；对于子模目标，最优设计对通信故障具有鲁棒性；对于加权最大覆盖，边际贡献效用设计可优化pPoA。
AI.motivation: 解决多智能体协调问题，其中系统设计者需要为智能体分配局部效用函数，以引导其行为实现期望的系统目标，并优化基于纯无政府价格（pPoA）的性能保证。
AI.method: 开发了一个线性规划（LP）模型，用于为任意信息网络和任意系统目标推导出最优的纯无政府价格（pPoA）。这项工作首次解决了任意网络的最优效用设计问题，并推广了之前只考虑完全信息设置的方法。
AI.result:
1. 对于超模目标函数，反直觉地证明了完全无通信的效用设计是最佳的，无论原始信息网络如何。
2. 对于子模系统目标，详尽的数值分析表明，即使在这种情况下，最优效用设计对通信故障也具有鲁棒性。
3. 当系统目标是加权最大覆盖时，边际贡献效用设计可证明地优化了各种相关信息网络的纯无政府价格。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地为任意信息网络和系统目标推导出了优化纯无政府价格（pPoA）的效用函数，并通过线性规划解决了最优效用设计问题，并针对不同类型的目标函数提供了具体的最佳设计策略。
AI.translation: 这项工作使用博弈论方法考虑了智能体之间具有任意信息网络的多智能体协调。系统设计者旨在为智能体分配局部效用函数，以引导其行为实现期望的系统目标。所分配的局部效用的性能通过众所周知的纯无政府价格（pPoA）指标来衡量，该指标等于相应博弈中最差纯纳什均衡处的系统目标与最优系统目标之比。我们的目标是推导出在任何给定信息网络和系统目标下，优化基于pPoA的性能保证的效用函数。我们开发了一个线性规划，可以为任何任意信息网络和任意系统目标推导出最优的pPoA。我们的工作首次解决了任意网络的最优效用设计问题；我们的技术推广了以前只考虑完全信息设置的方法。对于超模目标函数，我们反直觉地证明，无论原始信息网络如何，完全无通信的效用设计都是最佳的。对于子模系统目标，详尽的数值分析表明，即使在这种情况下，最优效用设计对通信故障也具有鲁棒性。当系统目标是加权最大覆盖时，边际贡献效用设计可证明地优化了各种相关信息网络的pPoA。
AI.summary: 本文研究了多智能体协调中的效用函数设计问题，旨在优化在任意信息网络和系统目标下的纯无政府价格（pPoA）性能。作者提出了一种线性规划方法来推导最优效用函数，并首次解决了任意网络下的最优效用设计问题。研究结果表明，对于超模目标函数，无通信效用设计是最佳的；对于子模目标，最优设计对通信故障具有鲁棒性；对于加权最大覆盖，边际贡献效用设计能有效优化pPoA。
AI.keywords: 纯无政府价格, 网络化资源分配, 博弈论, 效用设计, 信息网络
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于首次通过线性规划解决了任意信息网络下的最优效用设计问题，并推广了现有方法。特别引人注目的是，对于超模目标函数，反直觉地发现无通信效用设计是最佳的，这为多智能体系统设计提供了新的视角。该研究为网络化资源分配博弈中的机制设计提供了重要的理论和实践指导。

title: Feature Recovery for Object Understanding After Irreversible Fire Damage
summary: Objects in post-fire environments often undergo irreversible physical transformations that change their geometry, material state, and visual appearance. Detecting and identifying these remnants is critical for locating hazards, reconstructing pre-incident contents, and inventorying losses. Unlike standard image corruptions, these degradations affect the physical structure of the object itself. To study this setting, we introduce TRACE, a transformation-aware benchmark for post-fire object understanding. TRACE contains 21.4K real-image-grounded synthetic scenes and paired object-level pristine-to-degraded progressions spanning 499 object identities across 189 categories. We define five tasks targeting localization and pre-degradation understanding: degraded-object detection, pristine-state recovery and retrieval, original material recovery, pristine description generation, and functional reasoning. Existing models degrade sharply with severity. From the least to the most severe level, RF-DETR mAP decreases by 71% relative, while InternVL3.5 retrieval R@1 falls from 93.85 to 28.11. To address this, we propose the Feature Recovery Module (FRM), a plug-and-play module that maps degraded encoder features to pristine-aligned representations while keeping the host frozen. Trained only with paired feature supervision, FRM improves scene-level detection, CLIP/SigLIP2 feature recovery, and all four object-level VLM tasks, with larger gains under more severe degradation. Across VLM hosts and severity levels, relative gains average 12.5% for retrieval, 20.1% for material recovery, 13.2% for description generation, and 12.4% for functional reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 火灾不可逆损坏后用于物体理解的特征恢复
AI.tldr: 针对火灾后物体不可逆的物理损毁，本文提出了TRACE基准和一个即插即用的特征恢复模块（FRM），大幅提升了视觉与多模态模型在退化场景下的识别与恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 火灾环境中的物体会经历不可逆的物理变形、材质状态和视觉外观变化，而现有的检测与识别模型在面对这种严重的物理结构退化时性能会急剧下降，因此需要专门的基准和方法来解决这一现实难题。
AI.method: 引入了包含21.4K个真实图像基础合成场景的基准TRACE，涵盖5项针对定位和预退化理解的任务；并提出了一个即插即用、基于配对特征监督训练的特征恢复模块（FRM），将退化编码器特征映射到原始对齐的表示中，同时保持宿主模型冻结。
AI.result: 现有模型在严重退化下性能锐减（如RF-DETR mAP下降71%，InternVL3.5的R@1从93.85跌至28.11）。而引入FRM后，在场景级检测、特征恢复以及4项对象级VLM任务上均取得了显著提升，在检索、材质恢复、描述生成和功能推理上分别平均取得了12.5%、20.1%、13.2%和12.4%的相对增益。
AI.conclusion: 论文引入了TRACE基准并提出了特征恢复模块（FRM），实验证明FRM能够显著提升各类视觉和多模态大模型在火灾等严重退化场景下的物体理解、检测与恢复性能。
AI.translation: 火灾后环境中的物体通常会经历不可逆的物理转变，从而改变其几何形状、材质状态和视觉外观。检测和识别这些残留物对于定位危险、重建火灾前物品以及清点损失至关重要。与标准的图像退化不同，这些退化会影响物体本身的物理结构。为了研究这一场景，我们引入了TRACE，一个用于火灾后物体理解的转换感知基准。TRACE包含21.4K个真实图像基础合成场景以及跨越189个类别共499个物体身份的配对“原始-退化”演变序列。我们定义了5个针对定位和预退化理解的任务：退化物体检测、原始状态恢复与检索、原始材质恢复、原始描述生成以及功能推理。现有模型的性能随严重程度的增加而急剧下降。从最低到最高严重程度，RF-DETR的mAP相对下降了71%，而InternVL3.5的检索R@1从93.85跌至28.11。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了特征恢复模块（FRM），这是一个即插即用的模块，它将退化编码器特征映射到原始对齐的表征，同时保持宿主模型冻结。仅通过配对特征监督进行训练，FRM便提升了场景级检测、CLIP/SigLIP2特征恢复以及所有四个对象级VLM任务的性能，并且在更严重的退化下增益更大。跨VLM宿主和严重程度级别，检索、材质恢复、描述生成和功能推理的相对增益平均分别达到了12.5%、20.1%、13.2%和12.4%。
AI.summary: 本文针对火灾后物体经历的不可逆物理损坏问题，提出了名为TRACE的基准和一个即插即用的特征恢复模块（FRM）。FRM通过配对特征监督，将退化特征映射回原始对齐的表征，显著增强了现有视觉和多模态模型在严重退化场景下的理解与恢复能力。
AI.keywords: 火灾后物体理解, 转换感知基准, 特征恢复模块, 多模态大模型, 物理形态退化
AI.comments: 该论文针对火灾后物体经历的不可逆物理变形与损坏这一极具挑战性的现实场景，提出了首个转换感知基准 TRACE，并设计了即插即用的特征恢复模块（FRM），有效提升了现有视觉和多模态模型在严重退化条件下的理解与恢复能力。其创新性在于从物理结构破坏的视角切入，并提供了配对的监督方案。

title: MoPA: Coordinated Mobile Manipulation via Subsystem-Specific Perception Alignment
summary: Mobile manipulation requires perceptual evidence at different spatial scales for base motion and arm control, while the two action modalities remain kinematically coupled. Existing policies often employ specialized action generation for different subsystems but condition heterogeneous action branches on a shared perceptual representation, leaving subsystem-specific perception-action correspondence implicit. We present MoPA, a framework that aligns perceptual conditioning with mobility and manipulation while preserving coordination at the action level. Dual Perceptual Streams employ two mutually masked query banks to extract separate perceptual representations from a shared vision-language context. Perception2Action Adaptation jointly updates each query bank and its corresponding action stream at every layer of a structured Mixture-of-Transformers decoder, while enabling information exchange between the two action streams. Coupled conditional flow matching learns a joint vector field for coordinated generation of both action chunks. On the ManiSkill-HAB benchmark, MoPA achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three task suites. Across four real-world tasks, MoPA achieves a mean full-task success rate of 76.3%, outperforming the best baseline by 12.5 percentage points. Ablation studies and further analyses validate the effectiveness of the proposed design. Website is available at: https://mopa-policy.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: MoPA：通过子系统特定感知对齐实现协调移动操作
AI.tldr: MoPA是一种新的移动操作框架，通过双感知流和感知到动作适应来对齐感知与移动和操作，并在基准测试和现实世界任务中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的移动操作策略通常为不同子系统（基座运动和机械臂控制）采用专门的动作生成，但却基于共享的感知表示，使得子系统特定的感知-动作对应关系是隐式的，这阻碍了移动和操作的有效协调。
AI.method:
MoPA框架通过以下方式对齐感知条件与移动性和操作，同时在动作层面保持协调：
1. 双感知流（Dual Perceptual Streams）：使用两个相互掩蔽的查询库，从共享的视觉-语言上下文中提取独立的感知表示。
2. 感知到动作适应（Perception2Action Adaptation）：在结构化Mixture-of-Transformers解码器的每一层中，共同更新每个查询库及其对应的动作流，同时实现两个动作流之间的信息交换。
3. 耦合条件流匹配（Coupled conditional flow matching）：学习一个联合向量场，用于协调生成两个动作块。
AI.result:
1. 在ManiSkill-HAB基准测试的所有三个任务套件中，MoPA达到了最先进的性能。
2. 在四个真实世界任务中，MoPA实现了76.3%的平均全任务成功率，比最佳基线高出12.5个百分点。
3. 消融研究和进一步分析验证了所提出设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MoPA通过子系统特定的感知对齐，显著提高了移动操作的协调性和成功率，并在基准测试和真实世界任务中展现出卓越的性能。
AI.translation: 移动操作需要不同空间尺度的感知证据来控制基座运动和机械臂，同时这两种动作模式在运动学上是耦合的。现有策略通常为不同的子系统采用专门的动作生成，但将异构动作分支基于共享的感知表示，使得子系统特定的感知-动作对应关系是隐式的。我们提出了MoPA，一个通过子系统特定感知对齐实现协调移动操作的框架，它在保持动作层面协调的同时，将感知条件与移动性和操作对齐。双感知流采用两个相互掩蔽的查询库，从共享的视觉-语言上下文中提取独立的感知表示。感知到动作适应在结构化Transformer解码器的每一层共同更新每个查询库及其对应的动作流，同时实现两个动作流之间的信息交换。耦合条件流匹配学习一个联合向量场，用于协调生成两个动作块。在ManiSkill-HAB基准测试中，MoPA在所有三个任务套件中均实现了最先进的性能。在四个真实世界任务中，MoPA实现了76.3%的平均全任务成功率，比最佳基线高出12.5个百分点。消融研究和进一步分析验证了所提出设计的有效性。网站地址：https://mopa-policy.github.io/。
AI.summary: MoPA是一个针对移动操作的创新框架，旨在通过子系统特定的感知对齐来解决现有方法中感知-动作对应隐式的问题。它引入了双感知流以提取独立的感知表示，并通过感知到动作适应在Transformer解码器中协调这些流与各自的动作。此外，耦合条件流匹配用于联合生成协调的动作。实验结果表明，MoPA在ManiSkill-HAB基准和真实世界任务中均取得了最先进的性能，证明了其在实现高效协调移动操作方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 移动操作, 感知对齐, 双感知流, Transformer, 协调控制
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入子系统特定的感知对齐机制，解决了移动操作中基座运动和机械臂控制之间感知-动作对应关系不明确的关键问题。其创新点在于“双感知流”和“感知到动作适应”，使得不同动作模式能够拥有独立的感知表示，同时通过信息交换保持协调。这种方法在Transformer解码器中实现，并结合耦合条件流匹配进行动作生成，为多模态机器人控制提供了一个新颖且高效的解决方案。在基准测试和真实世界的显著性能提升，凸显了其重要性。

title: What Counts as a Mistake? Annotating Recitation Events in Quran Memorization Transcripts
summary: Checking Quran recitation from an ASR transcript requires distinguishing unresolved mistakes from repetitions, repairs, opening formulas and accepted spelling differences. We report a completed human annotation of 100 production recording cases: 348 scored units and 162 localized events across ten combined labels. An executable evaluator scores labels and word positions together. A plain diff reaches label-aware F1 0.525 and localization F1 0.826; adapted production cleaner/alignment components reach 0.518 and 0.786, with exact-span F1 0.505 for both. Correcting the adapter's word coordinates recovers all five annotated repetition events, showing why annotation interfaces must be checked before interpreting baseline failures. In a preliminary pilot, eight single 20-minute runs across three coding agents and eight models span label-aware F1 0.143 to 0.892: seven land far above every baseline, and one collapses below the naive diff from a missing normalization step. Across the six, 970 of 972 gold-event instances draw an overlapping prediction, so what remains is not detection but convention: span extent, and the labels whose boundary is stipulated by adjudication rather than visible in the text. Seven of 162 events defeat all six same-day runs, five of them one orthographic rule, and the strongest run still misses the same ones. No run annotated before building, so the pilot measures the algorithm half of the task only.

AI.title_translation: 什么算作错误？在古兰经记忆转录中注释朗诵事件
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了古兰经记忆转录中“错误”的定义和标注问题。通过对100个朗诵录音进行人工标注，并开发评估器，发现区分真正的错误与重复、修正等事件具有挑战性。结果表明，事件的准确识别更多取决于标注约定而非单纯的检测技术，且标注界面的验证对结果解释至关重要。
AI.motivation: 检查古兰经朗诵的ASR转录需要区分未解决的错误、重复、修正、开场白和可接受的拼写差异，这促使研究者探究如何准确定义和标注这些“错误”。
AI.method: 研究通过人工标注100个古兰经朗诵生产录音案例，共识别出348个评分单元和162个局部事件，涉及十个组合标签。开发了一个可执行的评估器来同时评分标签和词位置。通过与纯粹的diff工具以及改编的生产清理器/对齐组件进行比较来评估性能。此外，还进行了初步试点，涉及三名编码代理和八个模型。
AI.result: 纯粹的diff工具在标签感知F1上达到0.525，定位F1达到0.826。改编的生产清理器/对齐组件的标签感知F1为0.518，定位F1为0.786，精确跨度F1为0.505。纠正适配器的词坐标恢复了所有五个已标注的重复事件。初步试点显示，标签感知F1范围从0.143到0.892，其中七个运行远高于基线，一个因缺少规范化步骤而表现不佳。在六个运行中，972个黄金事件实例中有970个产生了重叠预测，表明关键在于约定而非检测。162个事件中有7个未能被所有六个同日运行检测到，其中五个与正字法规则有关。
AI.conclusion: 在古兰经朗诵转录中，准确识别“错误”的关键在于对事件跨度范围和标签边界的约定，而非单纯的事件检测。在解释基线失败之前，必须检查标注界面。初步试点结果表明，算法在任务的算法部分表现各异，仍有待进一步完善。
AI.translation: 检查古兰经朗诵的ASR转录需要区分未解决的错误、重复、修正、开场白和可接受的拼写差异。我们报告了一项已完成的100个生产录音案例的人工标注：348个评分单元和162个跨越十个组合标签的局部事件。一个可执行的评估器同时对标签和词位置进行评分。一个普通的diff工具在标签感知F1上达到0.525，在定位F1上达到0.826；改编的生产清理器/对齐组件达到0.518和0.786，两者的精确跨度F1均为0.505。纠正适配器的词坐标恢复了所有五个已标注的重复事件，这表明在解释基线失败之前必须检查标注界面。在一个初步试点中，三名编码代理和八个模型在八次单次20分钟的运行中，标签感知F1范围从0.143到0.892：七个远高于所有基线，一个因缺少规范化步骤而低于朴素diff。在这六个运行中，972个黄金事件实例中有970个产生了重叠预测，因此剩下的不是检测问题，而是约定问题：跨度范围，以及其边界由裁决而非文本可见性规定的标签。162个事件中有7个未能击败所有六个同日运行，其中五个是正字法规则，而最强的运行仍然遗漏了相同的事件。没有在构建之前进行任何运行标注，因此试点只测量了任务的算法部分。
AI.summary: 这篇论文探讨了在古兰经记忆转录中如何定义和标注“错误朗诵事件”。研究人员对100个录音案例进行了人工标注，区分了真正的错误与重复、修正等，并开发了一个评估器来评分标签和词位置。他们比较了不同基线方法的性能，发现虽然大多数事件可以被预测，但准确识别的关键在于对事件跨度及标签边界的约定。初步试点表明，算法表现差异显著，强调了标注界面检查的重要性，并指出当前研究主要关注算法部分，未来的工作需进一步完善。
AI.keywords: 古兰经朗诵, 错误标注, ASR转录, 事件检测, 人工标注
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它超越了单纯的技术检测，深入探讨了在ASR转录中识别“错误”的复杂性，并强调了“约定”在定义和标注这类事件中的核心作用。它还关注了标注方法论和人机交互界面对结果解释的影响。局限性在于初步试点仅测量了算法部分，尚未涵盖完整的标注流程，且部分特定事件的识别仍面临挑战。

title: Creating an Atomic User Model for Personality-Aware Large Language Model Interaction
summary: Assistants built on large language models are expected to write as their user would, and the dominant approach is single-channel: preferences summarised from conversation history and reinserted into context. This inverts the order of inference. Preferences are the task-dependent surface of a comparatively stable personality structure, so a system storing only preferences relearns the person whenever the task changes. First, we characterise personality seepage, where a prompt's linguistic surface carries a personality fingerprint the assistant mirrors without access to the personality behind it. Second, we propose the Atomic User Model (AUM), a human-readable representation organising a person as a stable identity nucleus with four interpretable shells (psychological, cognitive and experiential, behavioural, and social), plus cross-shell entries recording internal conflict and authenticity. Third, we treat AUM as a retrieval index over a person rather than a prompt prefix, with a pipeline where a task classifier, component-selection function and budgeted retriever return a small payload of fields at generation time. Fourth, we evaluate it with sixteen language-model-simulated participants, six style-sensitive tasks and three seeds, plus a synthetic scaling study of the retriever. Retrieving eight fields matched the style fidelity of the full user model on 23% of the context (211 tokens against 915), improved on flat preference notes by 0.24 points on a five-point scale (p < 0.001, dz = 0.50), and raised forced-choice identification of the participant's own voice from 14.9% to 42.7% (25% chance). Four pre-registered controls returned null, locating the effect in the representation rather than the search over it. The benefit is largest for participants the un-personalised assistant reproduces worst (rho = -0.61, p = 0.013): personalisation is worth most to those the default serves least.

AI.title_translation: 为个性化大型语言模型交互创建原子用户模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出原子用户模型（AUM），一种结构化且可检索的个性表示，以更有效和高效地实现大型语言模型（LLM）的个性化交互，优于传统的基于偏好的方法，尤其对默认模型表现不佳的用户效果显著。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型助手通过汇总对话历史中的偏好来实现用户风格匹配，但这种方法是单通道的，且偏好是任务依赖的表面现象。当任务改变时，系统需要重新学习用户，这颠倒了推理顺序，导致效率低下且无法捕捉稳定的个性结构。
AI.method: 首先，描述了“个性渗漏”现象，即提示的语言表面携带个性特征。其次，提出了原子用户模型（AUM），这是一种人类可读的表示，将个体组织为一个稳定的身份核心，包含四个可解释的壳层（心理、认知和经验、行为、社会），并记录内部冲突和真实性。第三，将AUM作为一个人而非提示前缀的检索索引，通过任务分类器、组件选择函数和预算检索器在生成时返回少量字段。第四，通过16个语言模型模拟参与者、6个风格敏感任务和3个种子进行评估，并进行了合成扩展研究。
AI.result: 检索8个字段在23%的上下文（211个token对比915个token）中与完整用户模型的风格保真度相匹配。与扁平偏好笔记相比，在五分制量表上提高了0.24分（p < 0.001, dz = 0.50）。将参与者自身声音的强制选择识别率从14.9%提高到42.7%（25%的随机机会）。四个预注册对照实验结果为空，表明效果源于表示本身而非搜索。对默认模型表现最差的参与者，个性化收益最大（rho = -0.61, p = 0.013）。
AI.conclusion: 个性化对于那些默认服务效果最差的用户来说，价值最大。原子用户模型提供了一种更有效和高效的个性化大型语言模型交互的方法。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型构建的助手被期望能像用户一样写作，而目前主流方法是单通道的：从对话历史中总结偏好并重新插入到上下文中。这颠倒了推理的顺序。偏好是一个相对稳定的个性结构的、任务依赖的表面现象，因此，一个只存储偏好的系统在任务改变时需要重新学习这个人。首先，我们描述了个性渗漏，即提示的语言表面携带了个性指纹，助手在没有访问其背后个性的情况下也会模仿。其次，我们提出了原子用户模型（AUM），这是一种人类可读的表示，将一个人组织为一个稳定的身份核心，包含四个可解释的壳层（心理、认知和经验、行为、社会），以及记录内部冲突和真实性的跨壳层条目。第三，我们将AUM视为一个人而非提示前缀的检索索引，其管道包含一个任务分类器、组件选择函数和预算检索器，在生成时返回少量字段。第四，我们用16个语言模型模拟参与者、6个风格敏感任务和3个种子进行评估，并进行了检索器的合成扩展研究。检索8个字段在23%的上下文（211个token对比915个token）中与完整用户模型的风格保真度相匹配，在五分制量表上比扁平偏好笔记提高了0.24分（p < 0.001, dz = 0.50），并将参与者自身声音的强制选择识别率从14.9%提高到42.7%（25%的随机机会）。四个预注册对照实验结果为空，表明效果在于表示本身而非对其的搜索。对于未个性化助手表现最差的参与者，其收益最大（rho = -0.61, p = 0.013）：个性化对那些默认服务效果最差的人最有价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为原子用户模型（AUM）的新型用户建模方法，旨在解决现有大型语言模型（LLM）个性化交互中，基于任务依赖偏好导致效率低下和个性捕捉不稳定的问题。AUM将用户个性结构化为稳定的核心和四个可解释的壳层，并作为可检索的索引，通过一个管道在生成时高效提取相关个性特征。实验结果表明，AUM在保持风格保真度、提高个性化效果方面显著优于传统方法，尤其对默认模型表现不佳的用户提供了最大的收益，证明了其在实现更深层次、更高效LLM个性化方面的潜力。
AI.keywords: 原子用户模型, LLM个性化, 用户建模, 个性渗漏, 检索增强
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提出了原子用户模型（AUM），它通过将用户个性解构为稳定的核心和多层可解释的壳层，并结合检索机制，克服了传统基于偏好方法的局限性。这种结构化的表示和高效的检索方式，使得LLM能够更准确、更稳定地捕捉和应用用户个性，而非仅仅依赖于任务相关的表面偏好。其重要性在于为未来个性化LLM交互提供了新的范式，尤其强调了对默认服务不佳用户的额外价值，这对于提升用户体验和模型公平性具有积极意义。该方法通过在效率（少量token）和效果（风格保真度提升）之间取得平衡，展现了实用性。

title: Receiver-Surface Hit Patterns via Legendre Approximation for Molecular Signal Detection
summary: Detecting whether a transmitter is actively communicating with a receiver is a fundamental problem in molecular communications. A spherical receiver may measure not only the number and arrival times of absorbed molecules, but also their absorption locations on the receiver surface. These locations contain a directional signature that is lost in count-only detection. In this letter, we develop a molecular signal detector based on a Legendre polynomial expansion of the receiver-surface hit density and extend it to a Legendre-based Viterbi sequence detector. By exploiting the surface-level directional signature of molecular arrivals, the proposed detectors provide geometry-aware, efficient, and better-performing alternatives to count-only detection.

AI.title_translation: 基于勒让德近似的分子信号检测接收器表面命中模式
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于勒让德多项式展开的分子信号检测器，利用分子到达的表面级方向性特征，比传统仅计数检测器性能更好。
AI.motivation: 在分子通信中，检测发射器是否与接收器主动通信是一个基本问题。传统的仅计数检测会丢失分子吸收位置的方向性特征。
AI.method: 开发了一种基于接收器表面命中密度勒让德多项式展开的分子信号检测器，并将其扩展到基于勒让德的维特比序列检测器。
AI.result: 所提出的检测器提供了几何感知、高效且性能优于仅计数检测的替代方案，利用了分子到达的表面级方向性特征。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用分子到达的表面级方向性特征，基于勒让德近似的检测器在分子信号检测中表现出更好的性能和效率。
AI.translation: 检测发射器是否与接收器主动通信是分子通信中的一个基本问题。球形接收器不仅可以测量吸收分子的数量和到达时间，还可以测量它们在接收器表面的吸收位置。这些位置包含在仅计数检测中丢失的方向性特征。在这封信中，我们开发了一种基于接收器表面命中密度勒让德多项式展开的分子信号检测器，并将其扩展到基于勒让德的维特比序列检测器。通过利用分子到达的表面级方向性特征，所提出的检测器提供了几何感知、高效且性能优于仅计数检测的替代方案。
AI.summary: 本文针对分子通信中的信号检测问题，提出了一种利用勒让德多项式展开接收器表面命中密度的新型分子信号检测器。该方法通过捕捉分子在接收器表面吸收位置的方向性特征，克服了传统仅计数检测丢失方向信息的缺点。研究表明，所提出的基于勒让德的检测器及其扩展的维特比序列检测器，在几何感知、效率和性能方面均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 分子通信, 信号检测, 勒让德近似, 接收器表面, 方向性特征
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将勒让德多项式近似应用于分子通信的信号检测，有效地利用了分子在接收器表面的吸收位置信息，弥补了传统仅计数检测的不足。这种方法提供了一种新的视角来提高分子信号检测的准确性和效率，对于未来分子通信系统的设计具有重要意义。

title: Does Video Memory Use What It Retrieves? A Causal Audit of Memory Specificity
summary: Video models increasingly use memory to preserve information over long sequences, with the assumption that gains come from retrieving and using the correct past content. Standard memory ablations test whether memory helps, but not whether the retrieved content is responsible. We test this directly with read-time memory substitution, which replaces the consumed memory value while leaving the rest of the computation unchanged. This separates memory benefit from memory specificity, the extent to which the gain depends on retrieved content. Across frozen video world models, identity-free controls containing no evaluation-specific content recover essentially the full benefit on Ego-Exo4D and 7-Scenes and about 70% on TUM. In the Ego-Exo4D dose response, recovery falls from 102% to 1% as these values move away from observed training-memory representations, supporting representation repair as the best-supported explanation in this setting. WorldMem shows graded dependence. A wrong memory from the same trajectory recovers 94.1% of the PSNR benefit relative to zero content, while a donor from a disjoint trajectory and biome recovers 43.7%. SAM 2 shows strong content dependence. On DAVIS, replacing the correct spatial memory with a valid wrong memory reduces mean region and boundary score from 0.926 to 0.182. At MOSEv2 reappearance, it falls from 0.459 to 0.000. These results show that memory gains can depend on generic representation support, broader context, or exact episodic content. Read-time substitution provides a direct way to distinguish them.

AI.title_translation: 视频记忆是否使用了它检索到的内容？记忆特异性的因果审计
AI.tldr: 本文通过“读时记忆替换”方法，探讨视频模型中记忆增益是来自检索到的特定内容还是泛化表示支持，发现其依赖性因模型和任务而异。
AI.motivation: 视频模型越来越多地使用记忆来保存长序列信息，但标准记忆消融实验只能测试记忆是否有帮助，而不能确定检索到的内容是否真正起作用。本研究旨在直接测试记忆增益是否依赖于检索到的特定内容。
AI.method: 采用“读时记忆替换”（read-time memory substitution）方法，即在不改变其他计算的情况下，替换被消耗的记忆值。这有助于区分记忆益处与记忆特异性（即增益对检索内容的依赖程度）。在冻结的视频世界模型、WorldMem和SAM 2上进行了实验。
AI.result: 在冻结的视频世界模型中，包含非评估特定内容的“无身份控制”在Ego-Exo4D和7-Scenes上几乎完全恢复了益处，在TUM上恢复了约70%。在Ego-Exo4D剂量响应中，随着替换值偏离观察到的训练记忆表示，恢复率从102%下降到1%，表明表示修复是最佳解释。WorldMem显示出分级依赖性：来自同一轨迹的错误记忆恢复了94.1%的PSNR益处，而来自不相交轨迹和生物群落的记忆恢复了43.7%。SAM 2显示出强内容依赖性：在DAVIS上，用错误的有效空间记忆替换正确记忆，平均区域和边界分数从0.926降至0.182；在MOSEv2再现时，从0.459降至0.000。
AI.conclusion: 记忆增益可以依赖于泛型表示支持、更广泛的上下文或精确的事件内容。读时替换提供了一种直接区分这些依赖性的方法。
AI.translation: 视频模型越来越多地使用记忆来保存长序列信息，其假设是收益来自于检索和使用正确的过去内容。标准的记忆消融实验测试的是记忆是否有帮助，但并未测试检索到的内容是否是原因。我们通过读时记忆替换直接测试这一点，该方法在不改变其他计算的情况下替换被消耗的记忆值。这区分了记忆益处与记忆特异性，即增益对检索内容的依赖程度。在冻结的视频世界模型中，不包含评估特定内容的无身份控制在Ego-Exo4D和7-Scenes上基本恢复了全部益处，在TUM上恢复了约70%。在Ego-Exo4D的剂量响应中，随着这些值远离观察到的训练记忆表示，恢复率从102%下降到1%，支持表示修复是此设置下最受支持的解释。WorldMem显示出分级依赖性。来自同一轨迹的错误记忆相对于零内容恢复了94.1%的PSNR益处，而来自不相交轨迹和生物群落的捐赠记忆恢复了43.7%。SAM 2显示出强内容依赖性。在DAVIS上，用有效的错误空间记忆替换正确的空间记忆，平均区域和边界分数从0.926降至0.182。在MOSEv2再现时，它从0.459降至0.000。这些结果表明，记忆增益可以依赖于泛型表示支持、更广泛的上下文或精确的事件内容。读时替换提供了一种直接区分它们的方法。
AI.summary: 本文通过引入“读时记忆替换”这一新颖方法，对视频模型中记忆使用的特异性进行了因果审计。研究发现，记忆增益的来源因模型和任务而异，可能依赖于泛型表示支持、更广泛的上下文信息或精确的事件内容。实验结果表明，在某些情况下（如冻结视频世界模型），非特定内容也能带来显著增益，而在其他情况下（如SAM 2），记忆内容特异性至关重要。
AI.keywords: 视频记忆, 记忆特异性, 读时记忆替换, 因果审计, 视频模型
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入“读时记忆替换”方法，提供了一种新颖且直接的方式来解耦视频模型中记忆益处与其内容特异性。这对于理解视频模型如何利用记忆机制，以及如何设计更高效、更具鲁棒性的记忆系统具有重要意义。研究揭示了不同模型和任务对记忆内容依赖程度的差异，挑战了“检索到的内容必须精确匹配才能有效”的传统假设，并提出了“表示修复”等替代解释。

title: Shards on a Shoestring: Empirical Characterization of NEAR Protocol Nightshade Sharding on Commodity Hardware
summary: NEAR Protocol's Nightshade architecture targets one million transactions per second (TPS) through horizontal sharding of both state and computation. Published benchmarks were produced on expensive Google Cloud Platform infrastructure costing approximately \$700 per hour, leaving a significant reproducibility gap for academic research. We present the first independent empirical characterization of NEAR Nightshade sharding on commodity hardware: a Chameleon Cloud bare-metal node with 48 hyperthreaded Intel Xeon cores, 128\,GB RAM, and HDD storage at 80--100\,MB/s. We systematically sweep shard count from $N{=}1$ to $N{=}24$, measuring aggregate TPS, per-shard TPS, block time, BFT finality, memory, and disk I/O. We identify three distinct bottleneck regimes: L3 cache pressure at low $N$, witness gossip pipeline saturation at mid $N$, and coherence collapse at high $N$. A key unexpected finding is that HDD write latency acts as implicit flow control for the witness gossip pipeline. Removing it via RAM-backed tmpfs causes complete chain stall at $N{=}16$, with a 29$\times$ spike in orphan witness rate at 47\% CPU utilization. Aggregate TPS peaks at $N{=}8$ (+40\% over $N{=}1$) then reverses, with per-shard TPS collapsing 23$\times$ by $N{=}24$. Our dataset provides the first commodity-hardware calibration baseline for the companion SimPy sharding simulator.

AI.title_translation: 小成本分片：NEAR Protocol Nightshade 分片在商用硬件上的实证特性分析
AI.tldr: 本文对NEAR Protocol的Nightshade分片架构在商用硬件上进行了首次独立实证分析，揭示了性能瓶颈、硬盘写入延迟的关键作用，并提供了商品硬件校准基线。

AI.summary: 本文在商用硬件上对NEAR Protocol的Nightshade分片架构进行了首次独立实证分析，以解决现有基准测试在昂贵基础设施上的重现性问题。研究系统地测试了不同分片数量下的性能指标，并识别出L3缓存压力、见证八卦管道饱和和一致性崩溃作为主要瓶颈。一个重要发现是HDD写入延迟意外地充当了流量控制，移除它会导致链停滞。研究表明总TPS在N=8时达到峰值，并为SimPy分片模拟器提供了商用硬件校准基线。
AI.keywords: NEAR Protocol, Nightshade, 分片, 商用硬件, 性能分析
