title: Earinter: A Closed-Loop System for Eating Pace Regulation with Just-in-Time Intervention Using Commodity Earbuds
summary: Rapid eating is common yet difficult to regulate in situ, partly because people seldom notice pace changes and sustained self-monitoring is effortful. We present Earinter, a commodity-earbud-based closed-loop system that integrates in-the-wild sensing, real-time reasoning, and theory-grounded just-in-time (JIT) intervention to regulate eating pace during daily meals. Earinter repurposes the earbud's bone-conduction voice sensor to capture chewing-related vibrations and estimate eating pace as chews per swallow (CPS) for on-device inference. With data collected equally across \modify{sessions in quiet and noisy environments}, Earinter achieves reliable chewing detection (F1 = 0.97) and accurate eating pace estimation (MAE: 0.18 $\pm$ 0.13 chews/min, 3.65 $\pm$ 3.86 chews/swallow), enabling robust tracking for closed-loop use. Guided by Dual Systems Theory and refined through two Wizard-of-Oz pilots, Earinter adopts a user-friendly design for JIT intervention content and delivery policy in daily meals. In a 13-day within-subject field study (N=14), the closed-loop system significantly increased CPS and slowed meal-level eating pace, with statistical signs of carryover on retention-probe days and generally favorable comfort and usability. These effects should be interpreted as changes in eating-pace regulation rather than evidence of weight loss. Our findings highlight how single-modality commodity earables can support practical, theory-driven closed-loop JIT interventions for regulating eating pace in the wild.

title: WHEREIS: IP Address Registration Geo-Consistency
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2308.12436
summary:
The five Regional Internet Registries (RIRs) provide the critical function of IP address resource delegation and registration. The accuracy of registration data directly impacts Internet operation, management, security, and optimization. In addition, the scarcity of IP addresses has brought into focus conflicts between RIR policy and IP registration ownership and use. The tension between a free-market based approach to IP address allocation and use versus policies to promote fairness and regional equity has resulted in litigation and debate that threatens the existence of the RIR system.
  We develop WHEREIS, a measurement-based system to geolocate delegated IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes at an RIR-region granularity, and systematically study where addresses are physically used post-allocation as well as the extent to which registration information is accurate. We define a taxonomy of registration "geo-consistency" that compares a prefix's measured geolocation against the allocating RIR's coverage region and the registered organization's location. While in aggregate over 98% of the prefixes we examine are consistent with our geolocation inferences, there is substantial variation across RIRs. We find that IPv6 registrations are no more consistent than IPv4, suggesting that structural, rather than technical, issues play an important role in allocations. We solicit additional information on inconsistent prefixes from network operators, IP leasing providers, and collaborate with three RIRs to obtain validation. We further show that the inconsistencies we discover manifest in three commercial geolocation databases. Finally, we focus on AFRINIC as a case study of particular importance. By improving the transparency around post-allocation prefix use, we hope to improve applications that use IP registration data and inform ongoing discussions over in-region IP address use and policy.

title: Machine Learning-Based Classification of Jhana Advanced Concentrative Absorption Meditation Using 7 Tesla Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging
summary:
Introduction: Jhana advanced concentrative absorption meditation (ACAM-J) involves profound changes in consciousness, making its neural correlates important for understanding consciousness and well-being. Prior neuroimaging has relied on univariate, group-level contrasts, leaving open whether ACAM-J carries distributed neural signatures decodable from individual scans. This study evaluates whether fMRI-derived regional homogeneity (ReHo) can classify ACAM-J using machine learning.
  Methods: We analysed 7T fMRI data from 20 advanced meditators who progressed through their standard ACAM-J sequence and two matched control tasks, plus intensive data from one case-study participant held out for final evaluation. ReHo maps were computed per segment and parcellated into 498 regions spanning cortex, subcortex, brainstem, and cerebellum. Within subject-wise stratified cross-validation, feature ranking, recursive feature elimination, and class balancing were applied to training data only; six classifier families were fitted, and the top three per contrast were combined by probability averaging.
  Results: Across 19 binary comparisons, the ensemble reached an overall average accuracy of 65.87% before and 66.82% after regressing out phenomenology-related variance, with an average Cohen's \k{appa} of 0.2443. Discrimination was strongest for the most separated states (ACAM-J1 vs ACAM-J6, 74.33% accuracy, \k{appa} = 0.5158), while adjacent states were harder to separate. Prefrontal and anterior cingulate areas contributed most to model decisions.
  Conclusion: ReHo patterns measured at 7T carry information distinguishing ACAM-J from control states and, more modestly, from one another, supporting the feasibility of multivariate decoding of advanced meditation and informing future work on its mechanisms and neuromodulation.

title: False positive bias in AI-powered speech-based cognitive screening for multilingual English speakers in the UK
summary: Conversational speech reveals early signs of cognitive decline, including dementia and mild cognitive impairment (MCI). AI models show promise for speech-based screening, yet most research focuses on monolingual groups. In the UK, dementia is projected to rise fastest among Black and Asian communities, where multilingualism is common, making equity assessment critical. We recruited 1,395 participants (monolingual English speakers and multilingual speakers from Sheffield/Bradford) and collected over 263 hours of speech via the CognoMemory agent. Multilingual participants spoke English alongside Somali, Chinese, or South Asian languages (Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Mirpuri, Arabic). We evaluated ASR (Whisper, Wav2Vec 2.0, NeMo) and downstream AI models for cognitive classification and MMSE regression. ASR accuracy showed no significant differences across groups. However, downstream models exhibited systematic disparities: multilingual speakers were more often misclassified as impaired, especially in memory, fluency, and reading tasks. False-positive rates were substantially higher for multilingual (28 to 37%) than monolingual (12 to 16%) speakers, meaning multilingual individuals were approximately 2.5 times more likely to receive incorrect impairment labels. These biases worsened when models were trained on DementiaBank. This is the first large-scale analysis of false-positive bias in speech-based AI cognitive screening for UK multilingual ethnic minorities. Despite strong overall performance, current models show measurable disparities affecting multilingual speakers. Addressing these biases is essential for safe, equitable deployment in diverse healthcare settings.

title: EventMemAgent: Hierarchical Event-Centric Memory for Online Video Understanding with Adaptive Tool Use
summary: Online video understanding requires models to perform continuous perception and long-range reasoning within potentially infinite visual streams. Its fundamental challenge lies in the conflict between the unbounded nature of streaming media input and the limited context window of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Current methods primarily rely on passive processing, which often face a trade-off between maintaining long-range context and capturing the fine-grained details necessary for complex tasks. To address this, we introduce EventMemAgent, an active online video agent framework based on a hierarchical memory module. Our framework employs a dual-layer strategy for online videos: short-term memory detects event boundaries and utilizes event-granular reservoir sampling to process streaming video frames within a fixed-length buffer dynamically; long-term memory structuredly archives past observations on an event-by-event basis. Furthermore, we integrate a multi-granular perception toolkit for active, iterative evidence capture and employ Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Agentic RL) to end-to-end internalize reasoning and tool-use strategies into the agent's intrinsic capabilities. Experiments show that EventMemAgent achieves competitive results on online video benchmarks. The code will be released here: https://github.com/lingcco/EventMemAgent.

title: WorkflowPerturb: Calibrated Stress Tests for Evaluating Multi-Agent Workflow Metrics
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems that generate structured workflows from natural-language requests are now deployed in production across cloud automation, DevOps, and enterprise orchestration. Operating them exposes a recurring change-management problem. Routine updates, such as re-running an input, swapping the LLM, or refactoring an agent's prompt or orchestration code, often produce workflows that differ substantially from validated references. Engineers then lack a principled way to decide whether a change is safe to ship. Automatic workflow evaluation is the natural tool, but in practice metric scores are poorly calibrated, and a numeric change rarely communicates the severity of the underlying degradation. We introduce WorkflowPerturb, a controlled benchmark that applies realistic, graded perturbations to golden workflows. It contains 4,973 golden workflows and 44,757 perturbed variants across three perturbation types (Missing Steps, Compressed Steps, Description Changes) at severities of 10%, 30%, and 50%. We benchmark multiple metric families, analyzing their sensitivity and calibration using expected score trajectories and instance-level alert rates. Our results characterize systematic differences across families and support severity-aware interpretation of workflow evaluation scores in change-management settings. WorkflowPerturb is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/microsoft/WorkflowPerturb .

title: Measuring Pragmatic Influence in Large Language Model Instructions
comments: Proceedings of the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: It is not only what we ask large language models (LLMs) to do that matters, but also how we ask them. Phrases like ``This is urgent'' or ``As your supervisor'' can shift model behavior without altering task content. We study this effect as pragmatic framing, contextual cues that shape directive interpretation rather than task specification. While prior work exploits such cues for prompt optimization or probes them as security vulnerabilities, pragmatic framing itself has received comparatively little attention as a target of controlled measurement in instruction following. To support its systematic study as a measurable property, we introduce a framework that combines three components: directive-framing decomposition separating framing context from task specification; a taxonomy organizing 400 instantiations of framing into 13 strategies across 4 mechanism clusters; and priority-based measurement that quantifies influence through observable shifts in directive prioritization. Evaluating five open-weight LLMs across different families and scales, we find that pragmatic framing produces systematic shifts in directive prioritization, and the effectiveness ranking of different strategies proves highly consistent across models. This reveals that susceptibility to pragmatic framing is a structured behavioral property of instruction-tuned systems. Measuring this susceptibility is a prerequisite for any deliberate response to it, and this work provides the framework to do so.
comment: Proceedings of the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)

title: Intrusive and Non-Intrusive Model Order Reduction for Airborne Contaminant Transport: Comparative Analysis and Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Numerical simulations of contaminant dispersion after a gas leakage incident at a chemical plant can provide valuable insights for both emergency response and preparedness. High-fidelity simulation approaches combine incompressible Navier-Stokes (INS) equations with advection-diffusion processes to model wind and concentration field. However, their computational cost increases rapidly for complex geometries and extended domains like urban environments. This renders them unfeasible in time-critical or multi-query "what-if" scenarios, making model order reduction (MOR) techniques particularly valuable for enabling fast, accurate predictions. This study describes a MOR-based, application-driven workflow for uncertainty-aware contaminant concentration prediction, demonstrated for a two-dimensional benchmark system. Starting with the model selection, relevant comparison criteria and trade-offs are discussed for well-established proper orthogonal decomposition based (non-)intrusive methods, applied to the computationally more demanding parametric INS problem. They include accuracy, computational efficiency, data requirements, and extrapolation capability. Based on these insights, a non-intrusive parametric reduced-order model is constructed that enables accelerated Monte Carlo simulations for estimating the influence of potential wind measurement uncertainties on the spatio-temporal concentration field. This enables extracting valuable information for local consequence analyses and evacuation planning. Simulation results are furthermore interactively visualized in a dashboard and can serve as a building block within broader decision-support systems.

title: Layered Safety: Enhancing Autonomous Collision Avoidance via Multistage CBF Safety Filters
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: This paper presents a general end-to-end framework for constructing robust and reliable layered safety filters that can be leveraged to perform dynamic collision avoidance over a broad range of applications using only local perception data. Given a robot-centric point cloud, we begin by constructing an occupancy map which is used to synthesize a Poisson safety function (PSF). The resultant PSF is employed as a control barrier function (CBF) within two distinct safety filtering stages. In the first stage, we propose a predictive safety filter to compute optimal safe trajectories based on nominal potentially-unsafe commands. The resultant short-term plans are constrained to satisfy the CBF condition along a finite prediction horizon. In the second stage, instantaneous velocity commands are further refined by a real-time CBF-based safety filter and tracked by the full-order low-level robot controller. Assuming accurate tracking of velocity commands, we obtain formal guarantees of safety for the full-order system. We validate the optimality and robustness of our multistage architecture, in comparison to traditional single-stage safety filters, via a detailed Pareto analysis. We further demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of our collision avoidance methodology on multiple legged robot platforms across a variety of real-world dynamic scenarios.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters

title: MedCollab: IBIS-Guided Multi-Agent Collaboration with Hierarchical Disease Relation Chains for Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is a gradual process of evidence integration, in which physicians move from symptoms and medical history to examinations, competing hypotheses, disease relations, and treatment decisions. Large language models have advanced medical text understanding and generation. Yet their clinical use remains limited by weak evidence grounding, opaque reasoning, and inconsistent links among differential diagnosis, final diagnosis, diagnostic basis, and treatment planning. We introduce MedCollab, a multi-agent framework for full-cycle clinical diagnosis and report generation. MedCollab coordinates specialist and examination agents according to patient records. It structures agent deliberation with an Issue-Based Information System (IBIS) protocol, so that each diagnostic position is supported by patient-specific evidence and medical knowledge. It also builds Hierarchical Disease Relation Chains (HDRC) to connect accepted hypotheses through progression, complication, and comorbidity relations. During multi-round deliberation, a verifier-guided consensus module evaluates evidence support, medical plausibility, and logical conflicts. It then adjusts agent contributions and filters unsupported reasoning. Experiments on ClinicalBench and MIMIC-IV show that MedCollab outperforms leading LLMs and medical multi-agent baselines in diagnostic accuracy, evidence consistency, and clinical reasoning quality. These results indicate that structured and auditable collaboration can produce more faithful and clinically coherent diagnostic reports.

title: Countdown-Code: A Testbed for Studying The Emergence and Generalization of Reward Hacking in RLVR
summary: Reward hacking is a form of misalignment in which models overoptimize proxy rewards without genuinely solving the underlying task. Precisely measuring reward hacking occurrence remains challenging because true task rewards are often expensive or impossible to compute. We introduce Countdown-Code, a minimal environment where models can both solve a mathematical reasoning task and manipulate the test harness. This dual-access design creates a clean separation between proxy rewards (test pass/fail) and true rewards (mathematical correctness), enabling accurate measurement of reward-hacking rates. Using this environment, we study reward hacking in open-weight LLMs and find that such behaviors can be unintentionally learned during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) when even a small fraction of reward-hacking trajectories leak into training data. As little as 1\% contamination in distillation SFT data is sufficient for models to internalize reward hacking which resurfaces during subsequent reinforcement learning (RL). We further show that RL amplifies misalignment and drives its generalization beyond the original domain. We open-source our environment and code to facilitate future research on reward hacking in LLMs. Our results reveal a previously underexplored pathway through which reward hacking can emerge and persist in LLMs, underscoring the need for more rigorous validation of synthetic SFT data. Code is available at https://github.com/zohaib-khan5040/Countdown-Code.

title: Tunable Latent Generative Priors for Compressed Sensing and Inverse Problems
summary: Latent generative models have emerged as powerful priors for solving inverse problems. These models typically represent a class of natural signals at a single, fixed complexity, governed by the latent dimensionality. This can be limiting: depending on the problem, a latent dimensionality that is too small may result in high representation error, while one that is too large may overfit to noise. We develop tunable latent priors for diffusion models, normalizing flows, and variational autoencoders, leveraging nested dropout. Across tasks including compressed sensing, inpainting, denoising, and phase retrieval, we show empirically that tunable priors consistently achieve lower reconstruction errors than fixed-complexity baselines. In the linear denoising setting, we derive the optimal complexity in closed form, showing how it depends on the noise level and the signal spectrum. This work demonstrates the potential of tunable latent generative priors and motivates both the development of supporting theory and their application across a wide range of inverse problems.

AI.title_translation: 面向压缩感知与逆问题的可调潜在生成先验
AI.tldr: 本文提出基于嵌套Dropout的可调潜在生成先验，解决了逆问题中固定潜维度带来的表征不足与过拟合矛盾，并在多种逆问题任务中取得了显著更低的重建误差。
AI.motivation: 传统的潜在生成模型通常在由潜在维度决定的单一固定复杂度下表征信号，潜空间维度过小会导致高表征误差，过大则容易过拟合噪声，无法根据具体逆问题灵活调整。
AI.method: 利用嵌套Dropout（nested dropout）机制，为扩散模型、归一化流和变分自编码器（VAE）构建了复杂度可调的潜在生成先验；并在理论上推导出了线性去噪场景下最优复杂度的闭式解。
AI.result: 在压缩感知、图像修复、去噪和相位恢复等任务中，该方法取得的重建误差均稳定低于固定复杂度的基线模型；理论推导揭示了最优复杂度与噪声水平及信号频谱的具体依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作证明了可调潜在生成先验在逆问题中的巨大潜力，并为后续相关理论研究以及在更广泛逆问题中的应用提供了有力启发。
AI.translation: 潜在生成模型已成为求解逆问题的强有力先验。这些模型通常在由潜在维度决定的单一、固定复杂度下表征一类自然信号。这种设定存在局限性：潜在维度过小可能导致较高的表征误差，而过大则可能过拟合噪声。我们利用嵌套Dropout（nested dropout），为扩散模型、归一化流和变分自编码器开发了可调的潜在先验。在包括压缩感知、修复、去噪和相位恢复等多项任务中，实验表明可调先验始终能够获得比固定复杂度基线更低的重建误差。在线性去噪场景下，我们推导出了最优复杂度的闭式解，揭示了其如何取决于噪声水平和信号频谱。这项工作展示了可调潜在生成先验的潜力，并推动了支持理论的发展及其在广泛逆问题中的应用。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统潜在生成模型作为逆问题先验时复杂度固定、易引发表征误差或过拟合的问题，提出了一种基于嵌套Dropout的可调潜在生成先验，适配于扩散模型、流模型及VAE等多种架构。该方法在多种逆问题任务中显著降低了重建误差，并在理论上推导了线性去噪最优复杂度的闭式解。
AI.keywords: 潜在生成先验, 逆问题, 压缩感知, 嵌套Dropout, 可调复杂度
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用嵌套Dropout机制赋予生成模型动态调整潜在空间维度的能力，巧妙解决了固定潜在维度在表征能力与噪声过拟合之间的权衡难题。同时，文章不仅在扩散模型、流模型及VAE等多类生成模型和多个逆问题任务上展现了经验优势，还在线性去噪场景中给出了最优复杂度的闭式理论解，理论与实验结合紧密。其局限性可能在于非线性复杂逆问题中最佳复杂度的自适应选取策略在摘要中未详细展开。

title: Trajectory Tracking Control Design for Autonomous Helicopters with Guaranteed Error Bounds
summary: This paper presents a systematic framework for computing formally guaranteed trajectory tracking error bounds for autonomous helicopters based on Robust Positive Invariant (RPI) sets. The approach establishes a closed-loop translational error dynamics which is cast into polytopic linear parameter-varying form with bounded additive and state-dependent disturbances. Ellipsoidal RPI sets are computed, yielding explicit position error bounds suitable as certified buffer zones in upper-level trajectory planning. Three controller architectures are compared with respect to the conservatism of their error bounds and tracking performance. Simulation results on a nonlinear helicopter model demonstrate that all architectures satisfy the derived bounds, while highlighting trade-offs between performance and the conservatism of the computed invariant set.

AI.title_translation: 自主直升机轨迹跟踪控制设计与误差界限保证
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于鲁棒正不变集的方法，用于计算自主直升机轨迹跟踪误差的形式化保证界限，并通过仿真验证了该方法。
AI.motivation: 确保自主直升机在轨迹跟踪过程中具有可证明的误差界限，以便在高级轨迹规划中作为认证缓冲区。
AI.method: 该方法建立了闭环平移误差动力学，并将其转换为具有有界加性扰动和状态相关扰动的多面体线性参数变化形式。通过计算椭球鲁棒正不变（RPI）集，获得了明确的位置误差界限。论文还比较了三种控制器架构在误差界限保守性和跟踪性能方面的表现。
AI.result: 在非线性直升机模型上的仿真结果表明，所有控制器架构都满足推导出的误差界限。同时，结果也突出了性能与计算不变集保守性之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 基于鲁棒正不变集的方法能够为自主直升机提供形式化保证的轨迹跟踪误差界限，并且在控制器设计中存在性能与保守性之间的权衡。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种系统框架，用于基于鲁棒正不变 (RPI) 集计算自主直升机轨迹跟踪误差的形式化保证界限。该方法建立了闭环平移误差动力学，并将其转换为具有有界加性扰动和状态相关扰动的多面体线性参数变化形式。计算了椭球RPI集，产生了明确的位置误差界限，适用于作为高级轨迹规划中的认证缓冲区。比较了三种控制器架构在误差界限的保守性及其跟踪性能方面的表现。在非线性直升机模型上的仿真结果表明，所有架构都满足推导出的界限，同时突出了性能与计算不变集的保守性之间的权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于鲁棒正不变 (RPI) 集的系统框架，用于形式化计算自主直升机轨迹跟踪的误差界限。通过将闭环误差动力学建模为多面体线性参数变化形式，并计算椭球RPI集，获得了可用于高级轨迹规划的明确位置误差界限。仿真结果验证了所提出方法在不同控制器架构下均能满足误差界限，并揭示了性能与不变集保守性之间的权衡。
AI.keywords: 自主直升机, 轨迹跟踪, 误差界限, 鲁棒正不变集, 控制器设计
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个系统框架，利用鲁棒正不变（RPI）集为自主直升机计算形式化保证的轨迹跟踪误差界限，这对于提升自主系统的安全性至关重要。其重要性体现在能够为自主系统提供可证明的性能保证，特别是在需要高可靠性的应用中。论文提到了性能与不变集保守性之间的权衡，这可能意味着在实际应用中需要仔细平衡安全性（保守性）和实际性能。

title: NS-VLA: Towards Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action Models
comments: 25 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Removed the submission checklist; the scientific content is unchanged from v2. Project page: https://zuzuzzy.github.io/NS-VLA/
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are formulated to ground instructions in visual context and generate action sequences for robotic manipulation. Despite recent progress, VLA models still face structure-blind backbones, backbone-bound generalization, and flat single-objective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action (NS-VLA) framework. It introduces a Neuro-Symbolic Encoder for plan-constrained primitive inference, a Neuro-Symbolic Solver that conditions a backbone-agnostic policy on the active primitive, and Hierarchical Joint Policy Optimization with reward-granularity matching. Experiments on robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that NS-VLA outperforms previous methods in both one-shot training and data-perturbed settings, while simultaneously exhibiting superior zero-shot generalizability and expanded exploration space. Our code is publicly available.

AI.title_translation: NS-VLA：迈向神经符号视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出NS-VLA框架，将神经符号基元推理与分层优化引入VLA模型，显著提升了机器人操作的零样本泛化与探索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型仍面临骨干网络缺乏结构感知（structure-blind backbones）、泛化能力受骨干网络限制（backbone-bound generalization）以及扁平的单目标优化（flat single-objective optimization）等问题。
AI.method: 提出NS-VLA框架，包含三个关键组件：1）用于规划约束基元推理的神经符号编码器（Neuro-Symbolic Encoder）；2）以活动基元为条件调节与骨干无关策略的神经符号求解器（Neuro-Symbolic Solver）；3）结合奖励粒度匹配的分层联合策略优化（Hierarchical Joint Policy Optimization）。
AI.result: 在机器人操作基准测试中，NS-VLA在单样本（one-shot）训练和数据扰动设置下均超越以往方法，同时展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力以及扩展的探索空间。
AI.conclusion: NS-VLA框架通过神经符号基元推理与分层策略优化，成功克服了传统VLA模型的结构与泛化瓶颈，在机器人操作中实现了更优越的泛化性与鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型旨在将指令置于视觉上下文中，并为机器人操作生成动作序列。尽管近期取得了一定进展，VLA模型仍面临骨干网络缺乏结构感知、泛化受限于骨干网络以及扁平的单目标优化等挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的神经符号视觉-语言-动作（NS-VLA）框架。该框架引入了用于规划约束基元推理的神经符号编码器、以活动基元为条件调节骨干网络无关策略的神经符号求解器，以及具有奖励粒度匹配的分层联合策略优化。在机器人操作基准上的实验表明，NS-VLA在单样本训练和数据扰动设置下均优于以往方法，同时展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力和扩展的探索空间。我们的代码已开源。
AI.summary: 针对VLA模型泛化受限与缺乏结构感知的挑战，本文提出了NS-VLA框架，通过神经符号编码器推断动作基元、神经符号求解器调节策略以及分层联合策略优化，显著提升了机器人操作在少样本、数据扰动和零样本场景下的表现。
AI.keywords: 神经符号AI, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 机器人操作, 零样本泛化, 策略优化
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将神经符号（Neuro-Symbolic）推理引入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，针对传统端到端VLA模型结构感知不足、泛化受限和单目标优化扁平的痛点，提出了结构化的基元推理与分层联合优化机制。其重要性在于显著提升了机器人在单样本和扰动环境下的泛化能力与探索效率。潜在局限性在于符号基元的设计与推理依赖度尚需进一步分析，具体基元系统的构建复杂度在摘要中未详述。

title: Data-Driven Successive Linearization for Optimal Voltage Control
summary: Power distribution systems are increasingly exposed to large voltage fluctuations driven by intermittent renewable generation and time varying loads (e.g., electric vehicles and storage). To address this challenge, a number of advanced controllers have been proposed for voltage regulation. However, these controllers typically rely on fixed linear approximations of voltage dynamics. As a result, the solutions may become infeasible when applied to the actual voltage behavior governed by nonlinear power flow equations, particularly under heavy power injection from distributed energy resources. This paper proposes a data-driven successive linearization approach for voltage control under nonlinear power flow constraints. By leveraging the fact that the deviation between the nonlinear power flow solution and its linearization is bounded by the distance from the operating point, we perform data-driven linearization around the most recent operating point. Convergence of the proposed method to a neighborhood of KKT points is established by exploiting the convexity of the objective function and structural properties of the nonlinear constraints. Case studies show that the proposed approach achieves fast convergence and adapts quickly to changes in net load.

AI.title_translation: 面向最优电压控制的数据驱动逐次线性化方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种数据驱动的逐次线性化方法，有效解决了配电网非线性潮流约束下的最优电压控制难题并具有收敛性保证。
AI.motivation: 间歇性可再生能源和时变负荷导致配电网电压波动剧烈，而现有控制器多依赖固定的线性化模型，在分布式能源高功率注入导致的非线性潮流环境下极易求得不可行解。
AI.method: 提出了一种非线性潮流约束下的数据驱动逐次线性化方法。利用非线性潮流解与线性化之间的偏差受距当前运行点距离界定的性质，在最新运行点周围进行数据驱动线性化；并利用目标函数凸性及非线性约束结构性质，证明了算法向KKT点邻域的收敛性。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，该方法能够实现快速收敛，并能够迅速适应净负荷的动态变化。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数据驱动逐次线性化方法能够有效解决非线性潮流约束下的电压控制问题，克服了传统固定线性化模型的不可行性缺陷，兼具坚实的理论收敛保证与出色的动态适应能力。
AI.translation: 由于间歇性可再生能源发电和时变负荷（例如电动汽车和储能）的影响，配电系统日益面临严重的电压波动。为应对这一挑战，已有研究提出了多种用于电压调节的先进控制器。然而，这些控制器通常依赖于电压动态的固定线性近似。因此，特别是在分布式能源大量注入功率的情况下，当应用于受非线性潮流方程支配的实际电压行为时，求解结果可能会变得不可行。本文提出了一种在非线性潮流约束下用于电压控制的数据驱动逐次线性化方法。利用非线性潮流解与其线性化之间的偏差受与运行点距离界定这一特性，我们在最新的运行点周围执行数据驱动线性化。通过利用目标函数的凸性和非线性约束的结构特性，证明了所提方法向KKT点邻域的收敛性。算例研究表明，该方法收敛速度快，且能快速适应净负荷的变化。
AI.summary: 本文针对可再生能源和时变负荷引发配电网电压波动及传统固定线性模型求解易不可行的问题，提出了一种基于数据驱动逐次线性化的最优电压控制策略。该方法在最新工作点周围进行动态局部线性化建模并具备理论收敛性保证，在保证非线性约束可行性的同时实现了快速收敛与负荷自适应。
AI.keywords: 电压控制, 逐次线性化, 数据驱动, 配电网, 非线性潮流
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将数据驱动的逐次局部线性化与非线性最优电压控制相结合，克服了传统固定线性化模型在高渗透率分布式资源下容易失真的致命缺陷，并给出了收敛到KKT点邻域的理论保证。局限性在于摘要中未详细说明数据驱动过程对量测噪声、通信延迟的敏感度以及算法在大规模电网下的可扩展性。

title: OA-NBV: Occlusion-Aware Next-Best-View Planning for Human-Centered Active Perception on Mobile Robots
summary: We naturally step sideways or lean to see around the obstacle when our view is blocked, and recover a more informative observation. Enabling robots to make the same kind of viewpoint choice is critical for human-centered operations, including search, triage, and disaster response, where cluttered environments and partial visibility frequently degrade downstream perception. However, many Next-Best-View (NBV) methods primarily optimize generic exploration or long-horizon coverage, and do not explicitly target the immediate goal of obtaining a single usable observation of a partially occluded person under real motion constraints. We present Occlusion-Aware Next-Best-View Planning for Human-Centered Active Perception on Mobile Robots (OA-NBV), an occlusion-aware NBV pipeline that autonomously selects the next traversable viewpoint to obtain a more complete view of an occluded human. OA-NBV integrates perception and motion planning by scoring candidate viewpoints using a target-centric visibility model that accounts for occlusion, target scale, and target completeness, while restricting candidates to feasible robot poses. OA-NBV achieves over 90% success rate in both simulation and real-world trials, while baseline NBV methods degrade sharply under occlusion. Beyond success rate, OA-NBV improves observation quality: compared to the strongest baseline, it increases normalized target area by at least 81% and keypoint visibility by at least 58% across settings, making it a drop-in view-selection module for diverse human-centered downstream tasks.

AI.title_translation: OA-NBV：面向移动机器人以人为中心的主动感知的遮挡感知型下一最佳视角规划
AI.tldr: OA-NBV是一种用于移动机器人的遮挡感知型下一最佳视角规划方法，能有效获取被遮挡人体更完整的视图，在模拟和真实环境中均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有的下一最佳视角（NBV）方法主要侧重于通用探索或长期覆盖，未能明确针对在杂乱环境中为部分被遮挡的人获取单个可用观测的即时目标。这对于搜索、分诊和灾难响应等以人为中心的操作至关重要，因为这些操作中杂乱环境和部分可见性常常会降低后续感知效果。
AI.method: 本文提出了OA-NBV，这是一个遮挡感知型NBV流程，旨在自主选择下一个可通行的视点，以获取被遮挡人体的更完整视图。OA-NBV通过使用以目标为中心的可见性模型（该模型考虑遮挡、目标尺度和目标完整性）对候选视点进行评分，同时将候选视点限制在可行的机器人姿态内，从而整合了感知和运动规划。
AI.result: OA-NBV在模拟和真实世界试验中均实现了超过90%的成功率，而基线NBV方法在遮挡下性能急剧下降。除了成功率，OA-NBV还提高了观测质量：与最强的基线相比，它在各种设置下将归一化目标面积至少增加了81%，关键点可见性至少增加了58%。
AI.conclusion: OA-NBV是一种有效的视图选择模块，可用于各种以人为中心的下游任务，能够显著提高对被遮挡人体的观测质量和成功率。
AI.translation: 我们自然地会侧身或倾斜身体来绕过障碍物，以获取更丰富的信息。使机器人能够做出同样的选择对于以人为中心的操作至关重要，包括搜索、分诊和灾难响应，在这些操作中，杂乱的环境和部分可见性常常会降低后续感知效果。然而，许多下一最佳视角（NBV）方法主要优化通用探索或长期覆盖，并未明确针对在真实运动约束下获取部分被遮挡人体的单个可用观测的即时目标。我们提出了面向移动机器人以人为中心的主动感知的遮挡感知型下一最佳视角规划（OA-NBV），这是一个遮挡感知型NBV流程，能够自主选择下一个可通行的视点，以获取被遮挡人体的更完整视图。OA-NBV通过使用以目标为中心的可见性模型（该模型考虑遮挡、目标尺度和目标完整性）对候选视点进行评分，同时将候选视点限制在可行的机器人姿态内，从而整合了感知和运动规划。OA-NBV在模拟和真实世界试验中均实现了超过90%的成功率，而基线NBV方法在遮挡下性能急剧下降。除了成功率，OA-NBV还提高了观测质量：与最强的基线相比，它在各种设置下将归一化目标面积至少增加了81%，关键点可见性至少增加了58%，使其成为适用于各种以人为中心的下游任务的即插即用型视图选择模块。
AI.summary: 本文提出了OA-NBV，一种用于移动机器人的遮挡感知型下一最佳视角规划方法。该方法旨在解决现有NBV方法在杂乱环境中难以有效获取被遮挡人体的可用观测问题。OA-NBV通过整合感知与运动规划，利用考虑遮挡、目标尺度和完整性的可见性模型来选择最佳视点。实验结果表明，OA-NBV在模拟和真实世界中均取得了超过90%的成功率，并显著提高了观测质量，使其成为以人为中心任务的有效视图选择模块。
AI.keywords: 遮挡感知, 下一最佳视角规划, 移动机器人, 人体感知, 主动感知
AI.comments: OA-NBV的创新之处在于其明确地将遮挡感知整合到下一最佳视角规划中，并通过以目标为中心的可见性模型来优化对被遮挡人体的观测。这对于以人为中心、需要高可靠性感知的任务（如救援）具有重要意义。该方法通过整合感知和运动规划，确保了选定视点的可行性，并展示了在复杂环境中的鲁棒性。

title: Translationese as a Rational Response to Translation Task Difficulty
comments: WMT at EMNLP 2026 Camera-ready, accepted 08 September 2026
summary: Translated texts exhibit systematic differences from comparable texts originally written in the target language. Explaining this phenomenon, commonly known as translationese, remains an open challenge. Translationese has been attributed to production tendencies (e.g. interference, simplification), socio-cultural variables, and language-pair effects, yet a unified explanatory account is lacking. We investigate the hypothesis that translationese is a response to the cognitive load inherent in the translation task. We test whether observable translationese can be predicted from quantifiable measures of translation task difficulty. Translationese is measured as a segment-level probability of being a translation produced by an automatic classifier (translatedness score). Translation task difficulty includes source-text and cross-lingual transfer components. They are captured by information-theoretic metrics based on LLM surprisal and by established syntactic and semantic alternatives. We use a bidirectional English-German corpus comprising written and spoken subcorpora. Results indicate that translationese can only be explained in part by translation task difficulty, especially in the English-to-German direction. For most experiments, cross-lingual transfer difficulty contributes more than source-text complexity. Information-theoretic indicators match or outperform traditional features in written mode, but offer no advantage in spoken mode. Source-text syntactic complexity and translation-solution entropy emerged as the strongest predictors of translationese across language pairs and modes.
comment: WMT at EMNLP 2026 Camera-ready, accepted 08 September 2026

AI.title_translation: 作为翻译任务难度理性反应的翻译腔
AI.tldr: 翻译腔部分是对翻译任务难度和认知负荷的一种理性反应，其中跨语言转移难度和源文本句法复杂度是关键预测指标。
AI.motivation: 现有的翻译腔（Translationese）解释（如生产倾向、社会文化变量、语言对效应等）缺乏一个统一的解释框架，本研究旨在检验翻译腔是否是对翻译任务中固有认知负荷的一种理性反应。
AI.method: 使用双向英德语料库（包含书面和口语子语料库），将翻译腔量化为自动分类器的“翻译倾向得分”，并将翻译任务难度（源文本和跨语言转移成分）通过基于大语言模型困惑度（surprisal）的信息理论指标及传统句法、语义特征进行量化，测试其对翻译腔的预测能力。
AI.result: 结果表明，翻译腔只能部分由翻译任务难度解释（尤其是在英语到德语的方向上）；在大多数实验中，跨语言转移难度的贡献大于源文本复杂度；源文本句法复杂度和翻译解熵是预测翻译腔的最强指标。
AI.conclusion: 翻译腔可以部分地通过翻译任务难度来解释，其中跨语言转移难度较源文本复杂度贡献更大，而源文本句法复杂度和翻译解熵是跨语言对和模式下最强的预测指标。
AI.translation: 翻译文本与目标语言中原本撰写的可比文本表现出系统性的差异。解释这种通常被称为“翻译腔”的现象仍然是一个未解的挑战。翻译腔传统上归因于生产倾向（如干扰、简化）、社会文化变量以及语言对效应，然而目前仍缺乏统一的解释性说明。我们研究了“翻译腔是对翻译任务固有认知负荷的反应”这一假设。我们测试了可观测的翻译腔是否可以从可量化的翻译任务难度指标中预测出来。翻译腔被量化为由自动分类器判定为翻译的片段级概率（翻译倾向得分）。翻译任务难度包括源文本和跨语言转移成分，通过基于大语言模型困惑度（surprisal）的信息论指标以及传统的句法和语义替代指标来捕捉。我们使用了包含书面和口语子语料库的双向英德语料库。结果表明，翻译腔只能部分由翻译任务难度解释，尤其是在从英语到德语的方向上。在大多数实验中，跨语言转移难度的贡献大于源文本复杂度。在书面模式下，信息论指标匹配或优于传统特征，但在口语模式下没有优势。源文本句法复杂度和翻译解熵成为跨语言对和模式下翻译腔的最强预测指标。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了翻译腔是否为翻译任务难度的理性反应，通过信息论和传统指标对英德双向语料进行分析，发现翻译腔可部分由任务难度（特别是跨语言转移难度与句法复杂度）解释。
AI.keywords: 翻译腔, 任务难度, 认知负荷, 信息论, 语料库研究
AI.comments: 该论文新颖地从认知负荷和任务难度的角度来解释翻译腔（Translationese），结合了信息论指标与传统句法、语义特征，通过英德双向语料库进行了全面的实证研究，对理解机器与人类翻译的产物特征具有重要意义。

title: Dense Dynamic Scene Reconstruction and Camera Pose Estimation from Multi-View Videos
summary: We address the challenging problem of dense dynamic scene reconstruction and camera pose estimation from multiple freely moving cameras -- a setting that arises naturally when multiple observers capture a shared event. Prior approaches either handle only single-camera input or require rigidly mounted, pre-calibrated camera rigs, limiting their practical applicability. We propose a two-stage optimization framework that decouples the task into robust camera tracking and dense depth refinement. In the first stage, we extend single-camera visual SLAM to the multi-camera setting by constructing a spatiotemporal connection graph that exploits both intra-camera temporal continuity and inter-camera spatial overlap, enabling consistent scale and robust tracking. To ensure robustness under limited overlap, we introduce a wide-baseline initialization strategy using feed-forward reconstruction models. In the second stage, we refine depth and camera poses by optimizing dense inter- and intra-camera consistency using wide-baseline optical flow. Additionally, we introduce MultiCamRobolab, a new real-world dataset with ground-truth poses from a motion capture system. Finally, we demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art feed-forward models on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, while requiring less memory.

AI.title_translation: 密集动态场景重建和多视角视频中的相机姿态估计
AI.tldr: 提出一个两阶段优化框架，用于从多个自由移动相机进行密集动态场景重建和相机姿态估计，通过时空连接图实现鲁棒跟踪和深度细化，并引入新数据集，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 解决从多个自由移动相机进行密集动态场景重建和相机姿态估计的挑战性问题，现有方法仅处理单相机或需要固定预校准相机设备，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段优化框架。第一阶段，将单相机视觉SLAM扩展到多相机设置，通过构建时空连接图利用相机内部时间连续性和相机间空间重叠，实现一致的尺度和鲁棒跟踪，并引入宽基线初始化策略以应对有限重叠。第二阶段，通过优化使用宽基线光流的密集相机间和相机内一致性来细化深度和相机姿态。此外，还引入了新的真实世界数据集MultiCamRobolab。
AI.result: 1. 方法在合成和真实世界基准测试上显著优于最先进的前馈模型。2. 所需的内存更少。3. 引入了带有运动捕捉系统地面真实姿态的新真实世界数据集MultiCamRobolab。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过两阶段优化框架实现了从多视角视频进行密集动态场景重建和相机姿态估计，性能优越且内存占用少，解决了现有方法的局限性。
AI.translation: 我们解决了从多个自由移动相机进行密集动态场景重建和相机姿态估计的挑战性问题——当多个观察者捕捉一个共享事件时，这种设置自然而然地出现。先前的S方法要么只处理单相机输入，要么需要刚性安装、预校准的相机设备，这限制了它们的实际适用性。我们提出了一个两阶段优化框架，将任务解耦为鲁棒的相机跟踪和密集的深度细化。在第一阶段，我们通过构建一个时空连接图，利用相机内部时间连续性和相机间空间重叠，将单相机视觉SLAM扩展到多相机设置，从而实现一致的尺度和鲁棒跟踪。为了确保在有限重叠下的鲁棒性，我们引入了一种使用前馈重建模型的宽基线初始化策略。在第二阶段，我们通过优化使用宽基线光流的密集相机间和相机内一致性来细化深度和相机姿态。此外，我们引入了一个新的真实世界数据集MultiCamRobolab，该数据集具有来自运动捕捉系统的地面真实姿态。最后，我们证明我们的方法在合成和真实世界基准测试上都显著优于最先进的前馈模型，同时需要更少的内存。
AI.summary: 这篇论文提出了一个两阶段优化框架，用于解决从多个自由移动相机进行密集动态场景重建和相机姿态估计的难题。该框架首先通过构建时空连接图扩展单相机SLAM进行鲁棒的多相机跟踪和一致尺度估计，并引入宽基线初始化策略。接着，通过优化密集相机间和相机内一致性来细化深度和姿态。此外，论文还发布了一个新的真实世界数据集MultiCamRobolab。实验结果表明，该方法在性能上显著优于现有最先进模型，并且内存效率更高。
AI.keywords: 密集动态场景重建, 相机姿态估计, 多视角视频, 视觉SLAM, 优化框架
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过提出一个新颖的两阶段优化框架，有效地解决了多视角自由移动相机下的密集动态场景重建和相机姿态估计的挑战。其创新点在于将单相机SLAM扩展到多相机设置，并结合时空连接图和宽基线策略，显著提高了鲁棒性和实用性。引入新的真实世界数据集也为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。该方法在性能和内存效率上的优势使其具有重要的实际应用潜力。

title: HyGra: Accelerating Network-State Simulation for LLM Training in DCNs via Adaptive Packet-Flow Granularity
summary: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have driven substantial intelligent transformation across diverse industries. Commercial LLM training is typically performed over data center networks (DCNs) comprising hundreds to thousands of GPUs, with multiple devices collocated per node. As network scale expands, inter-node communication becomes a primary bottleneck to training efficiency. Network-state simulators therefore play a crucial role by enabling cost-effective evaluation of network configurations and parallelization strategies through faithful emulation of DCN dynamics during LLM training. However, existing simulators are constrained by a efficiency-fidelity tradeoff, as packet-level simulators (PLSs) incur prohibitive runtime overhead, whereas flow-level simulators (FLSs) compromise essential modeling accuracy. In this paper, we develop \texttt{HyGra}, a hybrid-granularity network-state simulator that exploits intrinsic network dynamics in LLM training to adaptively switch simulation granularity. Specifically, \texttt{HyGra} employs packet-level simulation during non-steady phases with transient fluctuations and flow-level simulation during steady phases with periodic patterns, thereby accelerating execution while preserving high fidelity. Moreover, it requires no specialized hardware, supports single-machine deployment, and is compatible with existing simulators. Experiments based representative commercial LLM workloads, including ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Qwen, show that \texttt{HyGra} achieves up to 15.4$\times$ speedup under single parallelization strategy and 7.8$\times$ under hybrid parallelization strategies while maintaining high accuracy.

AI.title_translation: HyGra：通过自适应包流粒度加速数据中心网络中LLM训练的网络状态模拟
AI.tldr: HyGra是一种混合粒度网络状态模拟器，通过在LLM训练的不同网络动态阶段自适应切换包级和流级模拟，解决了现有模拟器在效率和准确性之间的权衡，实现了显著的加速和高精度。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）训练在数据中心网络（DCN）中进行时，随着网络规模的扩大，节点间通信成为训练效率的主要瓶颈。现有的网络状态模拟器存在效率与精度之间的权衡：包级模拟器运行开销过大，而流级模拟器则牺牲了必要的建模精度。
AI.method: 本文开发了HyGra，一种混合粒度网络状态模拟器。它利用LLM训练中固有的网络动态，自适应地切换模拟粒度。具体来说，HyGra在具有瞬态波动的非稳定阶段采用包级模拟，在具有周期性模式的稳定阶段采用流级模拟。此外，它不需要专用硬件，支持单机部署，并兼容现有模拟器。
AI.result: 实验表明，在代表性的商业LLM工作负载（包括ChatGPT、DeepSeek和Qwen）下，HyGra在单一并行化策略下实现了高达15.4倍的加速，在混合并行化策略下实现了7.8倍的加速，同时保持了高精度。
AI.conclusion: HyGra通过自适应切换模拟粒度，成功解决了LLM训练中网络状态模拟器在效率和精度之间的权衡问题，显著加速了模拟过程并保持了高准确性。
AI.translation: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）推动了各个行业的重大智能转型。商业LLM训练通常在由数百到数千个GPU组成的数据中心网络（DCN）上进行，每个节点共置多个设备。随着网络规模的扩大，节点间通信成为训练效率的主要瓶颈。因此，网络状态模拟器通过忠实模拟LLM训练期间的DCN动态，实现对网络配置和并行化策略的经济高效评估，发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，现有模拟器受限于效率-精度权衡，因为包级模拟器（PLS）会产生过高的运行时开销，而流级模拟器（FLS）则会损害必要的建模精度。在本文中，我们开发了HyGra，一个混合粒度网络状态模拟器，它利用LLM训练中固有的网络动态自适应地切换模拟粒度。具体来说，HyGra在具有瞬态波动的非稳定阶段采用包级模拟，在具有周期性模式的稳定阶段采用流级模拟，从而在加速执行的同时保持高保真度。此外，它不需要专用硬件，支持单机部署，并兼容现有模拟器。基于代表性商业LLM工作负载（包括ChatGPT、DeepSeek和Qwen）的实验表明，HyGra在单一并行化策略下实现了高达15.4倍的加速，在混合并行化策略下实现了7.8倍的加速，同时保持了高精度。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了HyGra，一种针对数据中心网络中LLM训练的混合粒度网络状态模拟器。鉴于LLM训练中节点间通信瓶颈以及现有包级和流级模拟器在效率与精度上的权衡，HyGra通过识别网络动态中的稳定和非稳定阶段，自适应地在流级和包级模拟之间切换。这种方法使得HyGra能够在保持高精度的同时显著加速模拟过程。实验证明，HyGra在不同并行化策略下均能实现显著的加速效果，且无需专用硬件，支持单机部署。
AI.keywords: LLM训练, DCN, 网络模拟, 混合粒度, HyGra
AI.comments: HyGra的创新之处在于其自适应的混合粒度模拟方法，巧妙地解决了网络状态模拟中长期存在的效率与精度权衡问题。通过利用LLM训练网络流量的固有动态，它能够智能地选择最适合当前网络状态的模拟粒度。这对于大规模LLM训练的DCN设计和优化具有重要意义，因为它提供了一个高效且准确的评估工具。其无需专用硬件和兼容现有模拟器的特点也增强了其实用性和可部署性。

title: AtlasRAN: Timing-Aware Evaluation of Open-source 5G Platforms for Integrated Wireless Testbeds
summary:
Open-source fifth-generation (5G) and Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) experiments span simulation, host operating system (host-OS) emulation, software-defined radio hardware-in-the-loop testing, Open Radio Unit fronthaul deployments, wireless digital twins, and accelerator-backed radio access network (RAN) runtimes. These environments may expose similar interfaces while preserving different timing, input/output, synchronization, buffering, transport, and observability; \emph{functional compatibility is therefore not timing fidelity}.
  This paper presents AtlasRAN, a claim-to-capability framework for deciding what an open-source 5G platform can credibly measure. It combines two reference paths, an execution-regime matrix, and a measurement-backed case study comparing OpenAirInterface (OAI) radio-frequency simulator (RFSim) with the Sionna Research Kit (Sionna-RK), which offloads low-density parity-check (LDPC) decoding to CUDA while retaining the surrounding OAI host-OS path. From one to six users, aggregate uplink goodput falls from 114.59 to 35.09~Mb/s for OAI and from 103.34 to 35.01~Mb/s for Sionna-RK. At six users, both RFSim real-time factors are approximately 0.55, despite estimated cumulative LDPC work of 1.09~ms per transport block for OAI and 0.37~ms for Sionna-RK. Timing-normalized service remains 60.7--63.6~Mb per emulated second across complete runs, while falling host and accelerator utilization is consistent with an under-fed decoder. A twelve-user run is retained only as failure-region evidence because end-of-test traffic summaries are absent. The practical takeaway is that integrated wireless testbeds, edge platforms, artificial-intelligence-enabled RANs, and digital twins should report timing discipline, transport path, memory movement, and observability as first-class experimental variables.

AI.title_translation: AtlasRAN：集成无线测试平台中开源5G平台的时序感知评估
AI.tldr: AtlasRAN是一个框架，用于评估开源5G平台的可信测量能力，通过比较OpenAirInterface和Sionna Research Kit，揭示了功能兼容性不等于时序保真度，并强调了在集成无线测试平台中报告时序、传输路径和内存移动的重要性。
AI.motivation: 开源5G和O-RAN实验环境可能提供相似的接口，但在时序、I/O、同步、缓冲等方面存在差异，导致功能兼容性不等于时序保真度。因此，需要一个框架来评估这些平台的可信测量能力。
AI.method: 本文提出了AtlasRAN框架，用于判断开源5G平台能够可靠测量什么。它结合了两个参考路径、一个执行机制矩阵，并通过一个案例研究进行了验证，该案例比较了OpenAirInterface (OAI) 射频模拟器 (RFSim) 与Sionna Research Kit (Sionna-RK)，后者将低密度奇偶校验 (LDPC) 解码卸载到CUDA，同时保留了周围的OAI宿主操作系统路径。
AI.result: 在1到6个用户的情况下，OAI的总上行链路吞吐量从114.59 Mb/s下降到35.09 Mb/s，而Sionna-RK从103.34 Mb/s下降到35.01 Mb/s。在6个用户时，尽管OAI的累积LDPC工作量估计为每个传输块1.09 ms，Sionna-RK为0.37 ms，但两个RFSim的实时因子均约为0.55。时序归一化服务在整个运行过程中保持在每模拟秒60.7-63.6 Mb，而主机和加速器利用率下降与解码器供电不足一致。12个用户的运行仅作为故障区域证据保留，因为缺少测试结束流量摘要。
AI.conclusion: 集成无线测试平台、边缘平台、人工智能RAN和数字孪生应将时序规范、传输路径、内存移动和可观测性作为一流的实验变量进行报告。
AI.translation:
开源第五代 (5G) 和开放无线接入网络 (O-RAN) 实验涵盖了仿真、宿主操作系统 (host-OS) 仿真、软件定义无线电硬件在环测试、开放无线单元前传部署、无线数字孪生以及加速器支持的无线接入网络 (RAN) 运行时。这些环境可能暴露出相似的接口，同时保留不同的时序、输入/输出、同步、缓冲、传输和可观测性；因此，功能兼容性并非时序保真度。
本文提出了AtlasRAN，一个用于决定开源5G平台能够可靠测量什么的“能力声明”框架。它结合了两个参考路径、一个执行机制矩阵，以及一个基于测量的案例研究，比较了OpenAirInterface (OAI) 射频模拟器 (RFSim) 与Sionna Research Kit (Sionna-RK)，后者将低密度奇偶校验 (LDPC) 解码卸载到CUDA，同时保留了周围的OAI宿主操作系统路径。从1到6个用户，OAI的总上行链路吞吐量从114.59 Mb/s下降到35.09 Mb/s，而Sionna-RK从103.34 Mb/s下降到35.01 Mb/s。在6个用户时，尽管OAI的累积LDPC工作量估计为每个传输块1.09 ms，Sionna-RK为0.37 ms，但两个RFSim的实时因子均约为0.55。时序归一化服务在整个运行过程中保持在每模拟秒60.7-63.6 Mb，而下降的主机和加速器利用率与解码器供电不足一致。一个12个用户的运行仅作为故障区域证据保留，因为缺少测试结束流量摘要。实际的启示是，集成无线测试平台、边缘平台、人工智能RAN和数字孪生应将时序规范、传输路径、内存移动和可观测性作为一流的实验变量进行报告。
AI.summary: 本论文介绍了AtlasRAN，一个用于评估开源5G平台可信测量能力的框架。它强调了开源5G和O-RAN环境中功能兼容性与时序保真度之间的差异。通过比较OAI RFSim和Sionna-RK（利用CUDA卸载LDPC解码），研究发现即使在吞吐量相似的情况下，平台的实时因子和解码工作量也存在显著差异，表明解码器可能存在供电不足。研究结果强调，在集成无线测试平台中，时序纪律、传输路径、内存移动和可观测性应被视为关键的实验变量。
AI.keywords: AtlasRAN, 开源5G, O-RAN, 时序感知, 无线测试平台
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了AtlasRAN框架，旨在解决开源5G和O-RAN平台中功能兼容性与时序保真度不一致的关键问题。其通过实际案例研究揭示了在不同平台下，即使表面性能相似，底层时序和资源利用也可能存在显著差异，这对于构建可靠的集成无线测试平台具有重要指导意义。论文的局限性可能在于其案例研究的范围，以及对更复杂场景下时序行为的深入分析。

title: Dynamic Properties and Motion Reproducibility of a Compact Pneumatically Actuated Humanoid Upper Body for Data-Driven Control
comments: 26 pages, 21 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publiaction in Advanced Robotics
summary: Pneumatically-actuated anthropomorphic robots with high degrees of freedom (DOF) offer significant potential for physical human-robot interaction. However, precise control of pneumatic actuators is challenging due to their inherent nonlinearities. This paper presents the development of a compact 13-DOF upper-body humanoid robot. To assess the feasibility of an effective controller, we first investigate its key dynamic properties, such as actuation time delays, and confirm that its behavior is reproducible across repeated trials. Leveraging this reproducibility, we implement a preliminary data-driven controller for a 4-DOF arm subsystem based on a multilayer perceptron with explicit time delay compensation. The network was trained on random movement data to generate pressure commands for tracking arbitrary trajectories. In comparative evaluations on this subsystem, the data-driven controller achieved lower tracking errors than a traditional PID controller. This result suggests that data-driven approaches are a promising option for controlling complex, high-DOF pneumatic robots.

AI.title_translation: 紧凑型气动人形机器人上半身的动态特性和运动再现性，用于数据驱动控制
AI.tldr: 开发了一个紧凑型13自由度气动人形机器人上半身，并证明其运动可再现性。基于此，为4自由度手臂子系统实现了数据驱动控制器，其跟踪误差低于传统PID控制器，表明数据驱动方法对复杂气动机器人控制有前景。
AI.motivation: 气动执行器具有固有的非线性，导致其精确控制具有挑战性，尽管高自由度气动人形机器人对物理人机交互有巨大潜力。
AI.method: 开发了一个紧凑的13自由度人形机器人上半身。首先研究了其关键动态特性（如执行时间延迟），并确认了其行为在重复试验中是可再现的。利用这种可再现性，为4自由度手臂子系统实现了一个基于多层感知器并带有显式时间延迟补偿的初步数据驱动控制器。该网络通过随机运动数据训练，用于生成压力指令以跟踪任意轨迹。
AI.result: 机器人行为在重复试验中是可再现的。在4自由度手臂子系统上，数据驱动控制器比传统PID控制器实现了更低的跟踪误差。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动方法是控制复杂、高自由度气动机器人的一个有前景的选择。
AI.translation: 具有高自由度（DOF）的气动驱动拟人机器人为物理人机交互提供了巨大潜力。然而，由于气动执行器固有的非线性，其精确控制具有挑战性。本文介绍了一种紧凑型13自由度人形机器人上半身的开发。为了评估有效控制器的可行性，我们首先研究了其关键动态特性，例如执行时间延迟，并确认其行为在重复试验中是可再现的。利用这种可再现性，我们为4自由度手臂子系统实现了一个基于多层感知器并带有显式时间延迟补偿的初步数据驱动控制器。该网络通过随机运动数据训练，以生成压力指令来跟踪任意轨迹。在该子系统的比较评估中，数据驱动控制器实现了比传统PID控制器更低的跟踪误差。这一结果表明，数据驱动方法是控制复杂、高自由度气动机器人的一个有前景的选择。
AI.summary: 本文开发了一个紧凑型13自由度气动人形机器人上半身，并研究了其动态特性和运动再现性。利用其可再现性，研究人员为4自由度手臂子系统实现了基于多层感知器的数据驱动控制器，该控制器通过随机运动数据训练，并表现出比传统PID控制器更低的跟踪误差。这表明数据驱动方法在控制复杂、高自由度气动机器人方面具有潜力。
AI.keywords: 气动机器人, 数据驱动控制, 人形机器人, 运动再现性, 多层感知器
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过开发紧凑型气动人形机器人上半身并验证其运动再现性，为数据驱动控制提供了一个坚实的基础。其创新之处在于将数据驱动方法应用于解决气动执行器固有的非线性控制难题，并通过与传统PID控制器的比较，突出了其在跟踪精度上的优势，这对于复杂高自由度气动机器人的发展具有重要意义。

title: Rotated Robustness: A Training-Free Defense against Bit-Flip Attacks on Large Language Models
summary:
Bit-flip corruption of quantized weights poses a serious reliability threat to Large Language Models (LLMs), as even a small number of weight faults can trigger catastrophic model degradation. We show that such failures can be strongly amplified when corrupted weights are coupled to high-sensitivity activation channels. Based on this observation, we propose Rotated Robustness (RoR), a training-free sensitivity-aware hierarchical rotation that applies matched orthogonal transformations to activations and weights, redistributing sensitive channel contributions across feature dimensions while preserving the underlying linear mapping in exact arithmetic.
  Across eight evaluated LLMs, RoR matches or exceeds all compared methods in the number of cumulative PBS flips sustained before PPL exceeds 100 within the 100-flip evaluation horizon. Under BER-based random bit-flip injection, no RoR failures are observed in the evaluated 1,000-trial experiments for the tested models. Under defense-aware SPoF reconstruction, RoR increases the cost of reproducing specified one-bit catastrophic failures to thousands of deployed INT8 bit changes. RoR also preserves downstream-task utility under PBS perturbations. On NVIDIA H200 at batch size 8, RoR incurs 0.097\%--0.584\% persistent storage overhead, 5.2\%--14.1\% Prefill overhead, and 0.5\%--9.8\% Decode overhead across four representative models. These results show that sensitivity-aware hierarchical rotation provides a practical approach to improving the bit-flip robustness of quantized LLM Linear weights.

AI.title_translation: 旋转鲁棒性：一种针对大型语言模型比特翻转攻击的免训练防御
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Rotated Robustness (RoR) 的免训练方法，通过对激活和权重应用匹配的正交变换来防御量化大型语言模型中的比特翻转攻击，有效提高了模型鲁棒性且开销较低。
AI.motivation: 量化权重的比特翻转损坏对大型语言模型（LLMs）构成严重的可靠性威胁，因为即使少量权重故障也可能引发灾难性的模型性能下降。研究发现，当损坏的权重与高敏感度激活通道耦合时，这种故障会被强烈放大。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种名为Rotated Robustness (RoR) 的免训练、敏感度感知分层旋转方法。该方法对激活和权重应用匹配的正交变换，在保持底层线性映射精确算术的同时，重新分配敏感通道的贡献。
AI.result: 在八个评估的LLM中，RoR在PPL超过100之前所能承受的累积PBS翻转次数方面，与所有对比方法持平或超越。在基于BER的随机比特翻转注入下，在测试模型的1000次评估实验中未观察到RoR故障。在防御感知单点故障（SPoF）重建下，RoR将重现指定单比特灾难性故障的成本增加到数千次部署的INT8比特更改。RoR还在PBS扰动下保持了下游任务的实用性。在NVIDIA H200上，批处理大小为8时，RoR在四个代表性模型上产生了0.097%–0.584%的持久存储开销，5.2%–14.1%的Prefill开销，以及0.5%–9.8%的Decode开销。
AI.conclusion: 敏感度感知分层旋转为提高量化LLM线性权重的比特翻转鲁棒性提供了一种实用的方法。
AI.translation:
**标题翻译**: 旋转鲁棒性：一种针对大型语言模型比特翻转攻击的免训练防御

**摘要翻译**: 量化权重的比特翻转损坏对大型语言模型（LLMs）构成严重的可靠性威胁，因为即使少量权重故障也可能引发灾难性的模型性能下降。我们发现，当损坏的权重与高敏感度激活通道耦合时，这种故障会被强烈放大。基于这一观察，我们提出了旋转鲁棒性（Rotated Robustness，RoR），这是一种免训练、敏感度感知的分层旋转方法，它对激活和权重应用匹配的正交变换，在保持底层线性映射精确算术的同时，重新分配敏感通道的贡献。
在八个评估的LLM中，RoR在PPL超过100之前所能承受的累积PBS翻转次数方面，与所有对比方法持平或超越。在基于BER的随机比特翻转注入下，在测试模型的1000次评估实验中未观察到RoR故障。在防御感知单点故障（SPoF）重建下，RoR将重现指定单比特灾难性故障的成本增加到数千次部署的INT8比特更改。RoR还在PBS扰动下保持了下游任务的实用性。在NVIDIA H200上，批处理大小为8时，RoR在四个代表性模型上产生了0.097%–0.584%的持久存储开销，5.2%–14.1%的Prefill开销，以及0.5%–9.8%的Decode开销。这些结果表明，敏感度感知的分层旋转为提高量化LLM线性权重的比特翻转鲁棒性提供了一种实用的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Rotated Robustness (RoR) 的免训练防御机制，用于解决量化大型语言模型中比特翻转攻击导致的可靠性问题。RoR通过对激活和权重应用匹配的正交变换，重新分配敏感通道的贡献，从而显著增强了模型对比特翻转的鲁棒性。实验结果表明，RoR在多个LLM上表现优异，能有效抵御随机和防御感知攻击，同时保持下游任务性能，并具有较低的计算和存储开销。
AI.keywords: 比特翻转攻击, 大型语言模型, 鲁棒性, 免训练, 正交变换
AI.comments: RoR的创新点在于其“免训练”和“敏感度感知分层旋转”的设计，通过重新分配敏感通道的贡献，从根本上提高了LLM对比特翻转攻击的鲁棒性，而无需额外的训练成本。其在性能、效率和攻击成本增加方面的表现，使其成为LLM部署中一个极具前景的实用防御方案。

title: FEAT: A Linear-Complexity Foundation Model for Extremely Large Structured Data
summary: Structured data is widely used in domains such as healthcare, finance, and scientific data management. Recent studies on structured data foundation models (SFMs) aim to support data analysis and mining tasks over such data, but still face scalability and generalization challenges when applied to real-world enterprise databases. First, many SFMs rely on full self-attention, which introduces an O(N^2) computational bottleneck and limits the number of tuples that can be processed jointly. Second, directly replacing attention with linear-complexity sequence models may conflict with the permutation-invariant nature of structured data, introducing artificial order bias and degrading representation quality. Moreover, models trained only on synthetic data may struggle to generalize to the heavy-tailed and heterogeneous distributions commonly found in real-world databases. To address these challenges, we propose FEAT, a linear-complexity foundation model for extremely large structured data. FEAT replaces quadratic attention with a multi-layer dual-axis encoding architecture. It integrates an adaptive-fusion bidirectional state-space model (AFBM) with convolutional gated linear attention (Conv-GLA), enabling cross-tuple contextualization in O(N) time while supporting permutation-invariant representation learning. To improve robustness under real-world data skewness, FEAT further adopts a hybrid structural causal pre-training pipeline with a robust reconstruction objective. Experiments on 12 real-world database benchmarks show that FEAT consistently outperforms representative SFMs on zero-shot tasks and scales linearly with structured-data sample length, achieving up to 50x faster inference latency.

AI.title_translation: FEAT：一种针对超大型结构化数据的线性复杂度基础模型
AI.tldr: FEAT是一种线性复杂度的基础模型，通过多层双轴编码和混合结构因果预训练，解决了现有结构化数据基础模型的可扩展性和泛化性挑战，并在真实世界数据库上表现出优越性能和更快的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化数据基础模型(SFMs)在应用于真实世界企业数据库时面临可扩展性和泛化性挑战。具体来说，许多SFMs依赖于全自注意力，导致O(N^2)计算瓶颈；直接用线性复杂度序列模型替代注意力可能与结构化数据的置换不变性冲突，引入人工顺序偏差并降低表示质量；仅在合成数据上训练的模型难以泛化到真实世界数据库中常见的重尾和异构分布。
AI.method: 本文提出了FEAT模型，用多层双轴编码架构取代二次注意力。FEAT集成了自适应融合双向状态空间模型(AFBM)和卷积门控线性注意力(Conv-GLA)，以在O(N)时间内实现跨元组上下文化，并支持置换不变表示学习。为提高在真实世界数据偏斜下的鲁棒性，FEAT还采用了具有鲁棒重建目标的混合结构因果预训练管道。
AI.result: 在12个真实世界数据库基准测试中，FEAT在零样本任务上持续优于代表性SFMs，并随结构化数据样本长度线性扩展，推理延迟加快高达50倍。
AI.conclusion: FEAT通过其创新的线性复杂度架构和鲁棒的预训练方法，有效解决了结构化数据基础模型在可扩展性和泛化性方面的挑战，并在真实世界应用中展现出显著的性能优势。
AI.translation: 结构化数据广泛应用于医疗保健、金融和科学数据管理等领域。近期对结构化数据基础模型（SFMs）的研究旨在支持对此类数据的数据分析和挖掘任务，但在应用于真实世界企业数据库时仍面临可扩展性和泛化性挑战。首先，许多SFMs依赖于完全自注意力，这引入了O(N^2)的计算瓶颈，并限制了可以联合处理的元组数量。其次，直接用线性复杂度序列模型替代注意力可能与结构化数据的置换不变性本质相冲突，引入人工顺序偏差并降低表示质量。此外，仅在合成数据上训练的模型可能难以泛化到真实世界数据库中常见的重尾和异构分布。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了FEAT，一个针对超大型结构化数据的线性复杂度基础模型。FEAT用多层双轴编码架构取代了二次注意力。它集成了自适应融合双向状态空间模型（AFBM）和卷积门控线性注意力（Conv-GLA），实现在O(N)时间内的跨元组上下文化，同时支持置换不变表示学习。为了提高在真实世界数据偏斜下的鲁棒性，FEAT进一步采用了具有鲁棒重建目标的混合结构因果预训练管道。在12个真实世界数据库基准测试上的实验表明，FEAT在零样本任务上持续优于代表性SFMs，并随结构化数据样本长度线性扩展，推理延迟加快高达50倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出FEAT，一个针对超大型结构化数据的线性复杂度基础模型，旨在解决现有结构化数据基础模型在可扩展性和泛化性方面的局限性。FEAT通过多层双轴编码架构替代了二次注意力，并结合自适应融合双向状态空间模型和卷积门控线性注意力，实现了O(N)复杂度的置换不变表示学习。此外，FEAT采用混合结构因果预训练管道以增强对真实世界数据偏斜的鲁棒性。实验证明，FEAT在零样本任务上优于现有SFMs，并显著提升了推理速度。
AI.keywords: 结构化数据, 基础模型, 线性复杂度, 置换不变性, 自适应融合双向状态空间模型
AI.comments: FEAT的创新之处在于其采用线性复杂度的多层双轴编码架构，有效解决了传统自注意力模型的计算瓶颈，同时通过AFBM和Conv-GLA的结合确保了结构化数据置换不变性的处理。其混合结构因果预训练方法也增强了模型在真实世界复杂数据分布下的泛化能力和鲁棒性，对于推动结构化数据基础模型在实际企业应用中的落地具有重要意义。

title: Early Intervention for VFM-based Multimodal Medical Image Classification
comments: Extension of the EI paper (CVPR 2026 findings)
summary: Current methods for multimodal medical image classification (M3IC) face two major challenges. First, the prevailing "fusion after unimodal image embedding" paradigm cannot fully exploit the complementary and correlated information in the multimodal data. Second, the scarcity of labeled multimodal medical images, coupled with their substantial domain shift from natural images, impedes the use of cutting-edge Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) for medical image embedding. To jointly address the challenges, we propose a novel Early Intervention (EI) framework. Treating one modality as target and the rest as reference, EI harnesses high-level semantic tokens from the reference as intervention tokens to steer the target modality's embedding process at an early stage. For parameter-efficient VFM adaptation, we introduce Mixture of varied-rank LoRAs (MoR), which employs a small set of LoRA experts with distinct ranks and a bypass-allowed router. Extensive experiments on three public datasets, covering retinal disease recognition, skin lesion recognition, and knee anomaly classification, verify the effectiveness of the proposed method against a number of competitive baselines.
comment: Extension of the EI paper (CVPR 2026 findings)

AI.title_translation: 针对基于VFM的多模态医学图像分类的早期干预
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为早期干预（EI）的新框架，通过利用参考模态的高级语义令牌来引导目标模态的嵌入过程，以解决多模态医学图像分类中现有融合范式和VFM适应的挑战。同时引入了混合变秩LoRA（MoR）以实现参数高效的VFM适应。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态医学图像分类（M3IC）面临两大挑战：一是“单模态图像嵌入后融合”范式未能充分利用多模态数据中的互补和相关信息；二是标记多模态医学图像的稀缺性及其与自然图像的显著领域偏差，阻碍了尖端视觉基础模型（VFM）在医学图像嵌入中的应用。
AI.method: 我们提出了一个新颖的早期干预（EI）框架。该框架将一种模态视为目标，其余模态视为参考，利用参考模态中的高级语义令牌作为干预令牌，在早期阶段引导目标模态的嵌入过程。为了实现参数高效的VFM适应，我们引入了混合变秩LoRA（MoR），它采用一组具有不同秩的LoRA专家和一个允许旁路的路由器。
AI.result: 在三个公共数据集（包括视网膜疾病识别、皮肤病变识别和膝关节异常分类）上进行了广泛实验，验证了所提出方法相对于多个竞争基线的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的早期干预（EI）框架和混合变秩LoRA（MoR）方法有效地解决了多模态医学图像分类中信息融合不足和视觉基础模型适应性差的问题，并在多个医学图像分类任务中展现出优越的性能。
AI.translation: 当前多模态医学图像分类（M3IC）方法面临两大主要挑战。首先，流行的“单模态图像嵌入后融合”范式无法充分利用多模态数据中的互补和相关信息。其次，标记多模态医学图像的稀缺性，加上它们与自然图像之间显著的领域偏差，阻碍了尖端视觉基础模型（VFMs）在医学图像嵌入中的应用。为了共同解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的早期干预（EI）框架。EI将一种模态视为目标，其余模态视为参考，利用参考模态中的高级语义令牌作为干预令牌，在早期阶段引导目标模态的嵌入过程。为了实现参数高效的VFM适应，我们引入了混合变秩LoRA（MoR），它采用一组具有不同秩的LoRA专家和一个允许旁路的路由器。在三个公共数据集上，包括视网膜疾病识别、皮肤病变识别和膝关节异常分类，进行了广泛的实验，验证了所提出方法相对于多个竞争基线的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态医学图像分类中的信息融合不足和视觉基础模型（VFM）适应性差的问题，提出了一种早期干预（EI）框架。EI通过将一种模态视为目标，其他模态视为参考，并利用参考模态的高级语义令牌在早期阶段引导目标模态的嵌入过程。此外，为实现参数高效的VFM适应，引入了混合变秩LoRA（MoR）。在视网膜疾病、皮肤病变和膝关节异常分类等三个公共数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 早期干预, 多模态医学图像分类, 视觉基础模型, LoRA, MoR
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出“早期干预”框架，通过在嵌入过程早期融合多模态信息，有效解决了传统“后期融合”的弊端。同时，引入MoR机制以参数高效的方式适应VFM，对于稀缺的医学图像数据尤其重要。这种方法为多模态医学图像分析提供了一个有前景的方向，但其在更广泛和多样化的医学任务中的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Total Recall QA: A Verifiable Evaluation Suite for Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents have emerged as LLM-based systems designed to perform multi-step information seeking and reasoning over large, open-domain sources to answer complex questions by synthesizing information from multiple information sources. Given the complexity of the task and despite various recent efforts, evaluation of deep research agents remains fundamentally challenging. This paper identifies a list of requirements and optional properties for evaluating deep research agents. We observe that existing benchmarks do not satisfy all identified requirements. Inspired by prior research on TREC Total Recall Tracks, we introduce the task of Total Recall Question Answering and develop a framework for deep research agents evaluation that satisfies the identified criteria. Our framework constructs single-answer, total recall queries with precise evaluation and relevance judgments derived from a structured knowledge base paired with a text corpus, enabling large-scale data construction. Using this framework, we build TRQA, a deep research benchmark constructed from Wikidata-Wikipedia as a real-world source and a synthetically generated e-commerce knowledge base and corpus to mitigate the effects of data contamination. We benchmark the collection with representative retriever and deep research models and establish baseline retrieval and end-to-end results for future comparative evaluation.

title: Optimal Solutions for the Moving Target Vehicle Routing Problem with Obstacles via Lazy Branch-and-Price
summary: The Moving Target Vehicle Routing Problem with Obstacles (MT-VRP-O) seeks trajectories for several agents that collectively intercept a set of moving targets. Each target has one or more time windows where it can be visited, and the agents must avoid static obstacles and satisfy speed and capacity constraints. Previously studied VRPs are often addressed using a framework called branch-and-price. This framework requires computing the cost for a single agent to visit a given sequence of target-time window pairings, for several candidate sequences. These sequences are called tours. Computing tour costs is more expensive in the MT-VRP-O than in previously studied VRPs due to the presence of both moving targets and static obstacles. Thus, we introduce a new exact algorithm, Lazy Branch-and-Price with Relaxed Continuity (Lazy BPRC), for the MT-VRP-O. The key idea in Lazy BPRC is to use cheap-to-compute lower bounds on tour costs where costs are traditionally used, and lazily update lower bounds to true costs. When computing a tour's true cost is needed, we do so by searching for a shortest path on a graph of convex sets, and we introduce a new heuristic to accelerate the search. We demonstrate that Lazy BPRC runs up to an order of magnitude faster than two ablations.

title: Folding the dragon
summary:
The Heighway Dragon Curve is one of the best known fractal curves. There are two ways to construct the curve: starting from a straight line segment, repeatedly make a copy of the current curve, rotate it by 90 degrees, and connect them; or repeatedly replace each straight segment in the curve by two segments with a right angle. A natural question is: how do we prove the equivalence of the two approaches?
  We generalise the construction of the curve to allow rotations to both sides. It then turns out that the two approaches are respectively a foldr and a foldl, and that the key property for proving their equivalence, using the second duality theorem, is the distributivity of an `interleave' operator.

title: Decomposing Discrimination: Causal Mediation Analysis for AI-Driven Credit Decisions
comments: I need to rework on some of the major findings and revise it
summary: Statistical fairness metrics in AI-driven credit decisions conflate two causally distinct mechanisms: discrimination operating directly from a protected attribute to a credit outcome, and structural inequality propagating through legitimate financial features. We formalise this distinction using Pearl's framework of natural direct and indirect effects applied to the credit decision setting. Our primary theoretical contribution is an identification strategy for natural direct and indirect effects under treatment-induced confounding -- the prevalent setting in which protected attributes causally affect both financial mediators and the final decision, violating standard sequential ignorability. We show that interventional direct and indirect effects (IDE/IIE) are identified under the weaker Modified Sequential Ignorability assumption, and prove that IDE/IIE provide conservative bounds on the unidentified natural effects under monotone indirect treatment response. We propose a doubly-robust augmented inverse probability weighted (AIPW) estimator for IDE/IIE with semiparametric efficiency properties, implemented via cross-fitting. An E-value sensitivity analysis addresses residual confounding on the direct pathway. Empirical evaluation on 89,465 real HMDA conventional purchase mortgage applications from New York State (2022) demonstrates that approximately 77% of the observed 7.9 percentage-point racial denial disparity operates through financial mediators shaped by structural inequality, while the remaining 23% constitutes a conservative lower bound on direct discrimination. The open-source CausalFair Python package implements the full pipeline for deployment at resource-constrained financial institutions.

title: An Empirical Markov Chain Car-Following (MC-CF) Model
summary: Car-following behavior is fundamental to traffic flow theory, yet traditional models often fail to capture the stochasticity of naturalistic driving. This paper proposes an empirical probabilistic sampling approach to car-following modeling that bypasses conventional parametric assumptions. Under this approach, we introduce the Markov Chain Car-Following (MC-CF) model, which represents state transitions as a Markov process and predicts behavior by randomly sampling accelerations from empirical distributions within discretized state bins. Evaluation on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset (WOMD) demonstrates that MC-CF variants significantly outperform all physics-based baselines (IDM, Gipps, FVDM, and SIDM) across both one-step and open-loop trajectory prediction metrics, and remain competitive with modern data-driven baselines including neural network and Gaussian mixture model approaches. Zero-shot generalization on the Naturalistic Phoenix (PHX) dataset further confirms cross-domain transferability. Finally, microscopic ring road simulations validate the framework's scalability: by incrementally integrating unconstrained free-flow trajectories and high-speed freeway data (TGSIM) alongside a conservative inference strategy, the model substantially reduces collisions across most tested scenarios and successfully reproduces naturalistic and stochastic shockwave propagation, though crashes persist under severe shockwave conditions. Overall, the proposed MC-CF model provides a robust and scalable foundation for simulating population-level stochastic traffic behavior that requires no behavioral parameter calibration, making it well-suited for the data-rich future of intelligent transportation.

title: Lax convergence theorems and error estimates of a finite element method for the incompressible Euler system
summary: In this paper, we present convergence theorems for numerical solutions of the incompressible Euler equations. The first result is the Lax-Wendroff-type theorem, while the second can be formulated in the framework of the Lax equivalence theorem. To illustrate their application, we study a finite element method that uses a pair of $RT_0/P_0$ elements to approximate the velocity and pressure, respectively. Applying the concept of the relative energy, we derive the convergence rates of our numerical method using two different approaches. Finally, we validate the theoretical convergence results through numerical experiments.

title: DeepStack: Facilitating Co-Design Exploration of 3D DRAM-Stacked Accelerators for Distributed LLM Inference
comments: MICRO version with three AE badges
summary: Advances in hybrid bonding and packaging have driven growing interest in 3D DRAM-stacked AI accelerators. As large language models (LLMs) scale to hundreds of billions or trillions of parameters, distributed inference across multiple 3D chips has become essential for AI serving. This trend makes cross-stack co-design critical because system-level parallelization and scheduling choices are tightly coupled with hardware characteristics such as memory organization, interconnects, and thermal constraints. We present DeepStack, an accurate performance model and efficient design space exploration (DSE) framework for distributed 3D-stacked LLM inference. At the hardware level, DeepStack captures transaction-aware memory bandwidth, bank activation constraints, buffering limitations, and thermal and power behavior. At the system level, it incorporates comprehensive parallelization strategies and execution scheduling. Through a dual-stage network abstraction and tile-level compute-communication overlap modeling, DeepStack achieves up to 100,000x faster evaluation than state-of-the-art simulators at comparable accuracy. We cross-validate DeepStack against our in-house 3D designs, an NS-3 backend with 2.12% error, and vLLM serving on eight B200 GPUs with 12.92% error. Combined with hierarchical search, DeepStack efficiently explores about 2.5 x 10^14 design points spanning the number of stacked DRAM layers, DRAM vertical connectivity, interconnects, compute-memory allocation, and distributed scheduling under thermal and area constraints. A search-space ablation shows that restricted DSE baselines can miss up to 9.5x modeled throughput. Beyond modeling and DSE, DeepStack derives design implications for distributed 3D AI systems and guides performance optimization across the stack. Source code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/tile-ai/DeepStack/tree/ae.
